items.title: 〈房產〉捷運宅同站租公寓Vs.大樓租金比較 房仲：亞東醫院站幾無價差
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Comparing Rental Prices of Apartments vs. High-Rise Buildings Near MRT Stations: No Price Gap at Yadong Hospital Station
paras: 租屋族偏好逐捷運而居，但不同住宅產品租金大不同，公寓與大樓價差幅度最大捷運站甚至超過 3 成。永慶房產集團根據租金實價登錄資料，統計近一年雙北捷運站周邊 800 公尺以內公寓與電梯大樓租金。數據顯示，秀朗橋站、景平站的公寓與大樓租金價差幅度最明顯，大樓皆比公寓貴高達 3 成以上。反觀亞東醫院站，大樓、公寓每月每坪租金價差幅度僅 0.2%。

大樓和公寓租金價差幅度最明顯的秀朗橋站、景平站，每坪價差幅度分別為 35.5%、31.9%；若以 20 坪房型為例，每月大樓租金比公寓貴 6,000 元以上。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍分析，兩站周邊公寓產品屋齡普遍較高；近年隨環狀線建設及周邊開發，大樓住宅陸續增加，因此有不少屋齡相對較新的電梯大樓，使兩類住宅的租金水準進一步拉開。值得注意的是，兩站電梯大樓租金總價中位數反而低於公寓，顯示大樓坪數大多比公寓來得小，有意租屋的民眾可視自身需求挑選。

六張犁站則是以價差幅度 28.9%，位居第三。公寓每坪月租 1,665 元、電梯大樓 2,147 元，單坪相差 482 元，若租 20 坪住宅，每月相差高達 9,600 元左右；而新北投站則名列第四。陳金萍表示，六張犁位於大安、信義兩大核心區交界，整體租金基準較高；不過因開發早，周邊以老公寓多，多分布於基隆路以東，電梯大樓屋齡偏新，且多位在更靠近商業中心基隆路以西，使得兩種產品租金差距更加明顯。新北投則因大樓多集中在捷運站周邊、生活機能較完善的路段，公寓則有不少屋齡較高、位置離主要商圈稍遠，因此租金單價也被進一步拉開差距。
反觀價差較小的站點，亞東醫院站公寓每坪月租 1,023 元、電梯大樓 1,026 元，每坪僅差 2 元，價差幅度僅 0.2%；居次則為南京三民站及淡水站，價差幅度分別為 1.8%、2.5%。陳金萍說，亞東醫院站周邊租屋需求主要來自醫療、就業及通勤族群，租客較重視租金負擔、交通便利性與室內空間，建物有無電梯對租金的影響相對有限。
而南京三民站由於區域生活機能成熟，公寓若鄰近捷運、屋況良好或經過整修，即使缺乏電梯，仍可維持一定租金行情，因此，也使兩類產品的租金水準相差不大。淡水站則因舊市區機能完善區域公寓較多，使公寓租金受到支撐；大樓多位於市區相對外圍的區域，即使有電梯優勢，租金仍受位置影響，讓兩者價差有限。
整體而言，陳金萍提醒，大樓通常具備電梯、管理、垃圾代收及門禁等優勢，每坪租金較高，但小坪數產品也可能出現「單價高、總價低」的情況。不過，除了建物型態外，屋齡、位置及捷運站周邊生活圈的發展狀況，都是影響租金的重要因素。此外，目前租金行情尚未強制進行全面實價登錄，實價登錄數據可能與實際市況有所落差，建議租屋族可上租房網站多加比較，或向在地房仲詢問，行情掌握才能更為全面。
paras_en: Renters tend to choose homes near MRT stations, but rental rates vary widely across housing types, with apartments and high‑rise buildings showing the largest gaps—sometimes exceeding 30% at certain stations. Based on actual rental registration data, the Yongqing Real Estate Group analyzed apartments and elevator‑equipped high‑rise rentals within 800 meters of MRT stations in Taipei and New Taipei over the past year. The data show that at Xiulang Bridge and Jingping stations the price gap between apartments and high‑rise buildings is most pronounced, with high‑rises costing more than 30% above apartments. In contrast, at Yadong Hospital station the monthly per‑ping price difference is only 0.2%.

At the stations with the most noticeable gaps—Xiulang Bridge and Jingping—the per‑ping price differences are 35.5% and 31.9% respectively; for a 20‑ping unit, a high‑rise rents over NT$6,000 more per month than an apartment. Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of Yongqing’s research center, explains that apartments near these stations tend to be older, while recent circular‑line construction and surrounding development have added many newer elevator‑equipped high‑rises, widening the rent differential. Notably, the median total rent for high‑rises is actually lower than for apartments, indicating that high‑rise units are generally smaller, so renters can choose based on their space needs.

Liuzhangli station ranks third with a 28.9% gap: apartments rent NT$1,665 per ping, while high‑rise buildings rent NT$2,147, a difference of NT$482 per ping. For a 20‑ping home the monthly gap reaches about NT$9,600. Beitou station ranks fourth. Chen notes that Liuzhangli sits at the junction of the Da’an and Xinyi core districts, where overall rents are high; many older apartments lie east of Keelung Road, while newer high‑rises are west of Keelung Road, closer to the commercial center, amplifying the price gap. At Beitou, most high‑rises cluster near the MRT and well‑served streets, whereas apartments tend to be older and farther from main commercial zones, further widening the rent difference.

Conversely, stations with small gaps show minimal differences. At Yadong Hospital, apartments rent NT$1,023 per ping and high‑rises NT$1,026—just NT$2 apart, a 0.2% gap. The next smallest gaps are at Nanjing Sanmin and Tamsui stations, at 1.8% and 2.5% respectively. Chen says rental demand around Yadong Hospital comes mainly from medical staff, employees and commuters who prioritize affordability, convenience and interior space, so the presence of an elevator has little impact on rent.

At Nanjing Sanmin, the mature local amenities mean that well‑located, well‑maintained apartments— even without elevators—can command comparable rents, keeping the gap small. At Tamsui, many older apartments in the historic downtown area support apartment rents, while high‑rise buildings are situated farther out; despite the elevator advantage, their rents are limited by location, resulting in a modest price difference.

Overall, Chen cautions that high‑rise buildings usually offer elevators, management, trash collection and access control, leading to higher per‑ping rents, but smaller units can exhibit “high unit price, low total price.” Besides building type, age, location and the development of the surrounding MRT‑area lifestyle circle are key rent drivers. Moreover, rental data are not yet fully mandated for comprehensive actual‑price registration, so official figures may differ from market reality. Renters should compare listings on rental websites or consult local agents to get a fuller picture of the market.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉國喬9月營收創新高 外資連3買加持開高攻漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Guojiao September Revenue Hits Record High, Foreign Investors Buy for Third Time Supporting Opening Surge to Upper Limit
paras: 塑化股國喬（1312-TW）受惠進入傳統旺季，9 月營收 41.55 億元、創歷史單月新高，月增 74.5%、年增達 96.81%，加上外資近期已連 3 買進場，激勵今（12）日股價開高後迅速攻上漲停板，盤中成交量爆量增至 8.3 萬張。
累計國喬前9 月營收為 208.24 億元、年增為 30.29%；公司認為，儘管石化產業目前仍面臨高油價、需求承壓及供給過剩等挑戰，但本業營運已有改善，未來將持續強化產品組合與營運效率，加強轉型布局。
國喬今年 8 月也宣布攜手日商 AWI 拓展台灣半導體材料市場，共同入股特殊氣體製造商宏廣新技，藉由 AWI 在工業氣體、產品技術與國際市場的經驗，透過優勢互補，成為國喬連結半導體材料供應鏈的重要布局。
國喬也將於高雄大社廠區新建高純度、高效率氫氣產線，建置太陽能綠能發電系統，以綠電專供氫氣純化製程使用，新產線預計在 2028 年上半年全面試俥量產，挹注營收。
國喬指出，除了本業外，因整體石化產業環境正在改變，未來競爭力不能只建立在傳統石化規模，也將既有製程、材料與產業經驗轉化為新的價值，未來國喬將透過國際合作與策略投資拓展高科技應用，布局相關國際市場。
paras_en: Plastics and chemicals company Guojiao (1312-TW) benefited from entering the traditional peak season, posting September revenue of NT$4.155 billion, a historic monthly high, up 74.5% month‑on‑month and 96.81% year‑on‑year. Foreign investors have bought the stock three consecutive times recently, spurring the share price to open higher on the 12th and quickly surge to the daily limit, with intraday volume exploding to 83,000 contracts.

Cumulative revenue for Guojiao in the first nine months of the year reached NT$20.824 billion, a 30.29% increase year‑on‑year. The company says that although the petrochemical sector still faces challenges such as high oil prices, pressured demand and oversupply, its core operations have improved. Going forward it will continue to strengthen its product mix and operational efficiency and reinforce its transformation strategy.

In August, Guojiao announced a partnership with Japan’s AWI to expand into Taiwan’s semiconductor materials market, jointly investing in specialty gas maker Hongguang New Technology. Leveraging AWI’s expertise in industrial gases, product technology and international markets, the collaboration aims to complement strengths and become a key part of Guojiao’s link to the semiconductor materials supply chain.

Guojiao will also build a new high‑purity, high‑efficiency hydrogen production line at its Dasha plant in Kaohsiung, installing a solar‑powered green energy system to supply electricity exclusively for hydrogen purification. The new line is slated for full trial production in the first half of 2028, which is expected to boost revenue.

Guojiao noted that beyond its core business, the overall petrochemical environment is changing, and future competitiveness cannot rely solely on traditional petrochemical scale. It will convert existing processes, materials and industry experience into new value, and expand high‑tech applications through international cooperation and strategic investments, targeting related overseas markets.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉和碩AI伺服器業務迎秋收 爆量衝漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Wistron AI Server Business Harvests Autumn, Surges to Limit‑Up
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)積極布局 AI 伺服器業務，承接輝達（NVDA-US）GB300 的雲端運算事業群「T1 專案」首批完成出貨，逐步迎來秋收期，並持續朝今年伺服器業績維持 10 倍成長目標前進，激勵和碩今（12）日爆量衝上漲停板。
和碩今天早盤以 95 元跳空開高，盤中衝上漲停板鎖死 98.6 元，一舉站上所有均線。截至 11 點 40 分，排隊委買單超過 9,000 張，成交爆量超過 4.6 萬張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超 1,807 張。
和碩 AI 伺服器開始出貨，加上客戶新手機開賣，帶動 9 月營收衝上 2,147.53 億元，年增逾 8 成，創歷史單月新高；第三季營收也衝上 3,890.26 億元，年增 5 成，為歷史同期新高。和碩持續看好旗下 AI 伺服器展望，預期今年營收占比有機會達到 1 成。
仁寶(2324-TW)布局 AI 伺服器效益也逐步發酵，第四季動能維持強勁，全年伺服器營收同樣有機會達 1 成，今天股價同步走揚，漲逾 2%，收復 5 日線及半年線。
paras_en: Wistron (4938‑TW) is actively expanding its AI server business, having delivered the first batch for Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) GB300 cloud computing “T1 Project.” The company is gradually entering its harvest season and continues to push toward its goal of a ten‑fold increase in server revenue this year, prompting a massive surge that sent the stock to its daily limit up on the 12th.

In early trading today, Wistron opened at NT$95 on a gap up, surged to the limit‑up price of NT$98.6, and locked in that level, climbing above all moving averages. By 11:40 a.m., buy‑order queues exceeded 9,000 lots and trading volume topped 46,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they net‑sold 1,807 lots last week.

Wistron’s AI servers have begun shipping, and the launch of a new customer smartphone boosted September revenue to NT$214.753 billion, up more than 80% year‑over‑year and setting a historic monthly high. Third‑quarter revenue also rose to NT$389.026 billion, a 50% year‑over‑year increase and a record for the same period. The company remains optimistic about its AI server outlook, expecting AI servers to account for about 10% of total revenue this year.

Compal (2324‑TW) is also seeing the benefits of its AI server rollout gradually materialize, with strong momentum carrying into Q4. Full‑year server revenue is likewise projected to reach roughly 10% of total sales, and its stock rose in tandem today, gaining over 2% to reclaim the 5‑day and six‑month moving averages.

items.title: 美光單季賺贏蘋果！記憶體缺貨 讓晶片供應商掌握定價權
items.title_en: Micron Beats Apple in Quarterly Earnings! Memory Shortage Gives Chip Supplier Pricing Power
paras: 記憶體短缺正改變科技業的獲利版圖。美光(MU-US) 截至9月30日的第四財季淨利達377億美元，超過蘋果(AAPL-US) 同期的298億美元，單季多賺約80億美元。當蘋果仍需採購晶片，美光卻無法滿足客戶需求，供需失衡讓美光掌握定價權，也使蘋果面臨毛利率下滑壓力。
市場策略師Charlie Bilello在X平台以三句話概括這項轉變：「蘋果需要晶片。美光有晶片。美光決定價格。」
他指出，美光淨利在短短兩年間暴增42倍至約380億美元，比蘋果上一季還多約80億美元，並直言：「我們從未見過這樣的定價權。」
美光獲利快速攀升，也反映在每股獲利上。2024財年，美光標準化每股獲利僅1.30美元，2026財年已升至75.52美元。涵蓋2027財年的35位分析師預估，每股獲利將進一步達到176.15美元，較前一年再增逾一倍。
美光預估，2027財年第一季營收將達615億美元，高於剛公布的542億美元。Ritholtz Wealth Management執行長Josh Brown評論，美光的業績指引不僅未遭下修，反而持續上調。
美光執行長Sanjay Mehrotra接受CNBC訪問時則表示：「事實上，我們根本無法滿足客戶需求。」
供應商的定價優勢，正轉化為客戶的成本負擔。蘋果毛利率曾從2021財年的41.8%，逐年攀升至2025財年的46.9%，但過去累積的緩衝空間，如今正受到記憶體漲價侵蝕。
排除關稅退款影響後，蘋果毛利率由3月當季的49.3%，降至6月當季的48.1%，並預估9月當季將進一步降至約46.5%。
蘋果管理層明確指出，記憶體成本是6月當季毛利率下滑的主要原因，也將持續拖累9月當季表現，先前囤積庫存帶來的緩衝效果則將在9月後逐步消退。
蘋果前執行長庫克在7月財報電話會議上，曾將記憶體價格上漲形容為「百年一遇的洪水」，凸顯成本壓力之大。
面臨衝擊的不只蘋果。Egerton Capital共同創辦人John Armitage在Podcast節目《In Good Company》中指出，記憶體成本通膨及其對物料成本的影響，也是輝達面臨的一大問題。不過，輝達擁有75%的毛利率，吸收成本衝擊的空間遠大於蘋果。
即使獲利大幅躍升，市場仍對美光的成長延續性抱持疑慮。目前美光預估本益比為5.9倍，遠低於三年平均的10.5倍，反映投資人對這波超級循環能維持多久仍有疑問。
根據TIKR分析，只要需求持續超過供給，美光的定價權就不會消失。
供給端另有勞資爭議變數。據路透報導，美光台灣桃園工廠工會有1,994名成員、占投票人數99%，因獎金糾紛投票授權罷工。
台灣是美光DRAM與HBM的重要生產基地，但工會強調，授權並不代表立即罷工，具體時間與細節仍在討論。若實際停工，可能進一步收緊供給，加重蘋果的記憶體採購壓力。
蘋果預計10月23日發售首款摺疊螢幕手機iPhone Duo，售價1,999美元，或有助將部分成本轉嫁給消費者，但現有財測顯示，蘋果仍在自行吸收這筆開銷。
隨著下一份財報預計於10月下旬公布，記憶體成本是否持續攀升，將成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: Memory shortages are reshaping the profit landscape of the tech industry. Micron (MU-US) posted a net profit of $37.7 billion for its fourth fiscal quarter ending September 30, surpassing Apple’s (AAPL-US) $29.8 billion for the same period by about $8 billion. While Apple still needs to purchase chips, Micron cannot meet all customer demand, creating a supply‑demand imbalance that gives Micron pricing power and puts pressure on Apple’s gross margin.
Market strategist Charlie Bilello summed up the shift in three sentences on X: “Apple needs chips. Micron has chips. Micron sets the price.”

He noted that Micron’s net profit has exploded 42‑fold in just two years to roughly $38 billion—about $8 billion more than Apple earned in the previous quarter—and said, “We’ve never seen pricing power like this.”

Micron’s profit surge is also reflected in earnings per share. For fiscal 2024, Micron reported a standardized EPS of $1.30, which rose to $75.52 for fiscal 2026. Thirty‑five analysts covering fiscal 2027 project EPS to climb further to $176.15, more than double the prior year’s level.

Micron forecasts first‑quarter revenue of $61.5 billion for fiscal 2027, above the recently announced $54.2 billion. Josh Brown, CEO of Ritholtz Wealth Management, commented that Micron’s guidance has not only avoided cuts but continues to be raised.
In a CNBC interview, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said, “The fact is, we simply cannot satisfy customer demand.”

The supplier’s pricing advantage is turning into a cost burden for customers. Apple’s gross margin rose from 41.8% in fiscal 2021 to 46.9% in fiscal 2025, but the buffer built up over the years is now being eroded by rising memory prices.
Excluding tariff refunds, Apple’s gross margin fell from 49.3% in the March quarter to 48.1% in the June quarter, and it is projected to drop further to about 46.5% in the September quarter.

Apple’s management explicitly said that memory costs were the main driver of the June‑quarter margin decline and will continue to drag down September‑quarter performance, while the cushioning effect of previously stockpiled inventory will gradually disappear after September.
Former Apple CEO Tim Cook described the surge in memory prices during the July earnings call as a “once‑in‑a‑century flood,” underscoring the magnitude of the cost pressure.

The impact is not limited to Apple. John Armitage, co‑founder of Egerton Capital, noted on the podcast “In Good Company” that memory‑cost inflation and its effect on material costs are also a major issue for Nvidia. However, Nvidia’s 75% gross margin gives it far more room to absorb cost shocks than Apple does.

Even with the profit jump, the market remains skeptical about Micron’s growth sustainability. Micron’s current forward P/E is 5.9×, well below its three‑year average of 10.5×, reflecting investor doubts about how long this super‑cycle can last.
According to TIKR analysis, as long as demand continues to outpace supply, Micron’s pricing power will not disappear.

On the supply side, labor‑relations issues add uncertainty. Reuters reported that the union at Micron’s Taoyuan, Taiwan plant, representing 1,994 members (99% of voters), voted to authorize a strike over a bonus dispute.

Taiwan is a key production hub for Micron’s DRAM and HBM, but the union stressed that authorization does not mean an immediate strike; timing and details are still being discussed. If a shutdown occurs, supply could tighten further, increasing pressure on Apple’s memory procurement.

Apple plans to launch its first foldable‑screen phone, the iPhone Duo, on October 23 at a price of $1,999, which could help shift some costs to consumers. However, current financial forecasts show Apple is still absorbing the expense itself.
With the next earnings report expected in late October, whether memory costs continue to rise will be a focal point for the market.

items.title: 亞馬遜傳砸70億美元收購AI新創Decart！搶攻AI晶片切換技術、強化算力布局
items.title_en: Amazon Plans $7 B Acquisition of AI Startup Decart to Boost Chip Switching Tech and Compute Power
paras: 據知情人士透露，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 正洽談收購人工智慧（AI）新創公司Decart，交易估值可能達到約70億美元。若交易順利完成，將進一步擴大亞馬遜在AI運算領域的布局，尤其Decart開發的軟體可協助開發者在不同AI晶片之間切換，隨著科技業競相爭奪運算資源，相關技術的重要性也日益提升。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，總部位於舊金山的Decart，其技術可降低開發者轉換不同AI晶片的難度。知情人士表示，若雙方談判未破局，也沒有其他潛在買家加入競爭，交易可能很快敲定。
根據PitchBook資料，Decart已從創投投資人募得超過4億美元，投資者包括紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）、Benchmark及Radical Ventures。今年5月，該公司的估值接近40億美元。
Decart於2023年由3名以色列工程師創立，分別為兄弟檔Dean Leitersdorf與Orian Leitersdorf，以及Moshe Shalev。
此外，該公司也正在開發名為Lucy與Oasis的世界模型（world models）。這類模型能夠生成並模擬真實世界的3D環境。
與此同時，亞馬遜正積極發展自研AI晶片Trainium3，與目前仍主導圖形處理器（GPU）市場的輝達(NVDA-US) 競爭。
GPU是支撐當前AI熱潮的重要硬體，隨著AI模型訓練與推論需求攀升，晶片供應及運算效率成為科技業競爭的關鍵。
根據《華爾街日報》先前報導，亞馬遜旗下雲端服務部門AWS於2025年與Decart接觸後，對其創辦團隊留下深刻印象，並讓Decart提前取得Trainium3晶片的使用權。
亞馬遜近年持續透過大型收購擴展業務版圖。2022年，亞馬遜以65億美元收購美高梅電影公司（MGM）。
今年稍早，亞馬遜也宣布以約110億美元收購Globalstar。 Globalstar被視為SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下星鏈（Starlink）的競爭對手之一。
以色列媒體Calcalist本月稍早亦報導，Decart正與一家大型科技公司進行深入的出售談判。
paras_en: According to sources, Amazon (AMZN-US) is in talks to acquire AI startup Decart in a deal that could be valued at about $7 billion. If completed, the purchase would further expand Amazon’s AI computing footprint, especially as Decart’s software helps developers switch between different AI chips, a capability growing in importance as tech firms vie for compute resources.

The Wall Street Journal reports that San‑Francisco‑based Decart has technology that reduces the difficulty for developers to transition between AI chips. Sources say that if negotiations stay on track and no other bidders emerge, the deal could be sealed quickly.

PitchBook data shows Decart has raised over $400 million from venture investors, including Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Radical Ventures. In May this year the company was valued at nearly $4 billion.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers: brothers Dean Leitersdorf and Orian Leitersdorf, along with Moshe Shalev.
The company is also developing world models called Lucy and Oasis, which can generate and simulate realistic 3D environments.
At the same time, Amazon is actively developing its own AI chip, Trainium 3, to compete with Nvidia (NVDA-US), which still dominates the GPU market.

GPUs are the key hardware powering the current AI boom, and as demand for model training and inference climbs, chip supply and compute efficiency have become critical competitive factors for the tech industry.
A previous Wall Street Journal report noted that after AWS first contacted Decart in 2025, the cloud unit was impressed by the founding team and gave Decart early access to Trainium 3 chips.
Amazon has been expanding its business through large acquisitions in recent years. In 2022 it bought MGM for $6.5 billion.
Earlier this year Amazon announced a roughly $11 billion acquisition of Globalstar, which is seen as a competitor to SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) Starlink satellite network.
Israeli media outlet Calcalist reported earlier this month that Decart is in deep sale negotiations with a major technology company.

items.title: 美50年數據敲警鐘：AI恐持續擠壓勞動所得  生產力與勞動份額持續分化
items.title_en: U.S. 50-Year Data Sounds Alarm: AI May Keep Squeezing Labor Income as Productivity and Labor Share Diverge
paras: AI浪潮之下，市場普遍擔憂技術迭代會進一步壓低勞工在國民所得中的分配佔比，美國過去五十年的生產力與薪資數據則為此討論提供關鍵參考。
數據顯示，美國企業每小時實際產出已較1973年翻倍，但勞工實際時薪漲幅並未同步。企業產出中的勞動份額，從1973年約63%下滑至2025年約55%，近期美國國民經濟核算修訂並未扭轉此一格局。
根據瑞銀分析，本次收入上調主要來自利息收入，勞動收入上調幅度有限，總量改善不等於勞工購買力同步提升。
需要釐清的是，生產力與實際薪酬採用兩套不同價格統計口徑。生產率使用企業產出價格折算，實際時薪依據CPI調整，兩組數據差值不能全部歸因為勞動收入轉移到資本。在2000年之前，統計口徑差異能解釋大部分差距，2000年後，勞動份額本身下檔成為主導因素。即便勞工實際報酬持續成長，其在總產出中佔比仍可能走低。勞動份額之外產出還需涵蓋資本折舊、利息與稅費，勞動佔比下滑幅度不等於企業利潤擴張幅度。

根據高盛上月對商業部門拆解的報告，勞動份額較1990年代平均值下降約7.5個百分點。該行估算，約四成降幅來自統計與分類偏差，並非真實所得分配轉移。一方面，1986年美國稅改推動企業改用穿透型組織架構，部分薪資收入計入企業利潤，直接壓低統計層面勞動份額。另一方面，電腦、軟體等短週期資產佔比提升推高折舊開支；勞動份額分母包含折舊，也會拉低佔比，不代表資本所有者獲得等額淨收益。同時股權激勵存在計算缺口，部分選擇權收益未能納入薪資統計，造成勞動報酬被低估。
剔除統計擾動後，剩餘約六成、接近4.5個百分點的降幅屬於真實分配變化。高盛認為，企業加價能力提升、自動化普及、勞動者議價能力走弱是核心驅動，三者交織難以單獨量化。市佔率向用工規模較小的「超級企業」集中，進一步拉低整體勞動份額；製造業機器人滲透率較高的行業，勞動份額降幅更明顯，工會力量弱化也削弱勞工議價能力。
對於AI帶來的影響，高盛提出關鍵判斷：勞動份額能否企穩，取決於AI替代勞工任務的速度與創造新職位的速度孰快孰慢。若任務替代持續快於崗位創造，勞動收入佔比或將進一步承壓。
短期經濟數據來看，根據瑞銀測算，2026年第二季美國非農業商業生產力年增2.3%，單位勞動成本成長2.2%，未見生產力大幅躍升，同期實質薪資收入年增0.8%，低於實質消費支出2.5%的成長速度；個人儲蓄率雖小幅上修至4.4%，仍低於一年前水準。科技變革的長期紅利如何更公平惠及勞工，仍是宏觀經濟需要直面的核心命題。
paras_en: Amid the AI wave, markets broadly worry that rapid technological iteration will further depress the share of national income that goes to workers. The United States’ productivity and wage data over the past fifty years provide a crucial reference for this debate.

The data show that U.S. firms’ real output per hour has doubled since 1973, but workers’ real hourly wages have not kept pace. The labor share of corporate output fell from about 63% in 1973 to roughly 55% in 2025, and recent revisions to the national accounts have not reversed this trend.

According to UBS analysis, the recent rise in total income comes mainly from higher interest earnings, while the increase in labor income is modest; a rise in aggregate income does not translate into an equivalent boost in workers’ purchasing power.

It is important to note that productivity and real compensation are measured using two different price bases. Productivity is valued at firm‑output prices, whereas real hourly wages are CPI‑adjusted. The gap between the two series cannot be fully attributed to a shift of labor income to capital. Before 2000, most of the divergence can be explained by the statistical‑definition difference; after 2000, a genuine decline in the labor share becomes the dominant factor. Even if workers’ real compensation keeps growing, its proportion of total output can still fall. The labor share’s denominator also includes capital depreciation, interest and taxes, so a drop in the labor share does not equal the magnitude of profit expansion.

Based on Goldman Sachs’ latest sector‑level report, the labor share is about 7.5 percentage points lower than its 1990s average. The bank estimates that roughly 40% of that decline stems from statistical and classification biases rather than a real shift in income distribution. One source is the 1986 U.S. tax reform that encouraged firms to adopt pass‑through structures, causing part of payroll to be recorded as corporate profit and thus lowering the reported labor share. Another is the rising share of short‑life assets such as computers and software, which raises depreciation expense; because depreciation is part of the labor‑share denominator, the share falls even though capital owners do not necessarily earn an equivalent net gain. In addition, gaps in equity‑compensation accounting mean that some stock‑option gains are omitted from wage statistics, further understating labor compensation.

After stripping out statistical distortions, about 60% of the decline—or roughly 4.5 percentage points—reflects a genuine redistribution. Goldman Sachs attributes this to three intertwined forces: firms’ growing pricing power, the spread of automation, and weakening bargaining power of workers. The effect is hard to isolate quantitatively. Market share is concentrating in “super‑large” firms that employ fewer workers per unit of output, pulling the overall labor share down; industries with high robot penetration, especially manufacturing, see an even sharper drop, and the erosion of union strength further weakens workers’ negotiating leverage.

Regarding AI’s impact, Goldman Sachs offers a key judgment: whether the labor share can stabilize depends on whether AI’s speed of substituting labor tasks outpaces the speed of creating new jobs. If task substitution continues to outstrip job creation, the labor‑income share will face additional pressure.

Short‑term data show that, according to UBS estimates, U.S. non‑farm business productivity grew 2.3% year‑over‑year in Q2 2026 and unit labor costs rose 2.2%, indicating no sharp productivity jump. Real hourly wages rose 0.8% year‑over‑year, lagging behind the 2.5% growth in real consumer spending. The personal savings rate was nudged up to 4.4% but remains below last year’s level. How the long‑run gains from technological change can be shared more equitably with workers remains a core macro‑economic challenge.

paras: 寬量國際(QIC)今(12)日指出，受惠於美系M9巨頭與AI獨立基礎建設商至2030年龐大資本支出，以及AI強權中唯一強勁淨現金部位的台灣前50大AI龍頭企業(T50)推動供應鏈在地化雙利多效應，看好500家台灣中小AI公司「QIC AI 500」市值於2030年成長5倍，來到2.7兆美元，成為最大贏家。
寬量國際創辦人暨執行長李鴻基指出，AI產業自2023年起已改變台灣資本市場樣貌，有20家20億美元以下的小型股，如川湖(2059-TW)、穎崴(6515-TW)、台光電(2383-TW)，以不到4年時間成為超過百億美元市值及全球AI供應鏈的T50企業，相信在M9資本支出效應帶動下，2030年會有更多T50公司來自目前的QIC AI 500。
根據寬量國際預估，2026至2030年間M9 (Microsoft、Amazon、Google、Meta、Oracle、SpaceX、Tesla、NVIDIA與Apple)以及AI獨立基礎建設商將投入高達6.5兆美元AI資本支出，年複合成長率(CAGR)高達35%，帶動T50企業AI相關營收自2025年1,793億美元成長至2030年的2.15兆美元，CAGR高達64%。
值得注意的是，台灣T50企業總現金部位2026年上半年已來到6.8兆元，年底前更有望突破10兆元大關，其淨現金部位亦創下1.6兆元歷史新高，展現出超越日韓龍頭企業的強健現金流與財務韌性，在供應鏈持續在地化帶動下，QIC AI500必成為全球超大型AI公司主導資本狂潮下，未來真正受益的中小型企業。
根據寬量國際團隊針對台灣「QIC AI 500」所進行的原創研究架構，在深入檢視台灣T50以外共計2,289家上市櫃及興櫃中小市值企業過去12個季度公開財報、法說會與公開資訊後，嚴選出500家實質受惠於AI浪潮的「QIC AI 500」明日之星，其中包含69家市值介於20至100億美元的中型股、227家市值介於3至20億美元的小型股，以及204家市值小於3億美元的微型股。
受惠於全球AI巨頭與T50供應鏈持續在地化雙利多效應，寬量國際預估「QIC AI 500」企業總營收將以18%的CAGR速度成長至2030年的6,650億美元，以「QIC AI 500」企業過去3年平均3.8倍的市值營收比(P/S)計算，「QIC AI 500」企業總市值預計將從目前4,880億美元成長5倍，於2030年達到2.66兆美元。
寬量國際「第20屆QIC CEO WEEK」投資論壇明天起在香港文華東方酒店舉行，向全球資本市場介紹「QIC AI 500」論述，除了10月13至14日實體論壇外，線上論壇則從10月20日起接續登場，共計34家頂尖台灣企業將與全球機構投資人展開深度對談，國家級新創品牌Startup Island TAIWAN則為贊助夥伴。
第20屆QIC CEO WEEK參與企業規模創下香港歷年新高，包括34家上市櫃、Pre-IPO與新創產業領袖，吸引超過100位橫跨國際創投、家族辦公室與頂尖機構投資人參加，與會國際機構投資人管理總資產(AUM)更是超過20兆美元。
paras_en: QIC International (QIC) said today (the 12th) that, thanks to massive capital spending by the US‑based M9 giants and independent AI infrastructure providers through 2030, as well as the dual‑benefit of localising the supply chain driven by Taiwan’s top 50 AI leaders (T50) – the only AI powerhouses with strong net‑cash positions – it expects the market value of 500 Taiwanese small‑ and mid‑cap AI firms in the “QIC AI 500” to grow five‑fold by 2030 to $2.7 trillion, making them the biggest winners.

Founder and CEO of QIC International, Li Hong‑ji, noted that the AI industry has reshaped Taiwan’s capital markets since 2023. Twenty small‑cap stocks under $2 billion – such as Chuanhu (2059‑TW), Ying‑wai (6515‑TW) and Tai Guangdian (2383‑TW) – have become T50 companies with market caps exceeding $100 billion and a role in the global AI supply chain in less than four years. He believes that, propelled by M9 capital‑spending effects, more T50 firms in 2030 will emerge from today’s QIC AI 500.

QIC estimates that between 2026 and 2030 the M9 group (Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta, Oracle, SpaceX, Tesla, NVIDIA and Apple) together with independent AI infrastructure providers will pour up to $6.5 trillion into AI capital spending, at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 35%. This will lift AI‑related revenue of T50 companies from $179.3 billion in 2025 to $2.15 trillion in 2030, a CAGR of 64%.

It is noteworthy that the total cash holdings of Taiwan’s T50 firms reached NT$6.8 trillion in the first half of 2026 and could break the NT$10 trillion threshold by year‑end. Their net‑cash position also hit a historic high of NT$1.6 trillion, showcasing cash‑flow strength and financial resilience that surpasses leading Japanese and Korean peers. With continued localisation of the supply chain, the QIC AI 500 are set to be the true beneficiaries among SMEs as ultra‑large AI companies drive a capital frenzy.

Based on QIC’s original research framework for Taiwan’s “QIC AI 500”, the team examined public filings, earnings calls and disclosures of 2,289 listed, over‑the‑counter and emerging‑board companies outside the T50 over the past 12 quarters. From this they rigorously selected 500 firms that stand to materially benefit from the AI wave – including 69 mid‑caps with market caps of $2‑$10 billion, 227 small‑caps of $300‑$2 billion, and 204 micro‑caps under $300 million.

Benefiting from the twin tailwinds of global AI giants and the ongoing localisation of the T50 supply chain, QIC projects total revenue of the QIC AI 500 to grow at an 18% CAGR to $665 billion by 2030. Using the historical average price‑to‑sales (P/S) multiple of 3.8× from the past three years, the combined market value of the QIC AI 500 is expected to rise five‑fold from the current $488 billion to $2.66 trillion by 2030.

QIC’s 20th‑edition CEO WEEK investment forum kicks off tomorrow at the Mandarin Oriental in Hong Kong, presenting the “QIC AI 500” thesis to global capital markets. In addition to the in‑person sessions on October 13‑14, an online forum will run from October 20 onward, featuring 34 leading Taiwanese companies in deep dialogues with global institutional investors. The national‑level startup brand Startup Island TAIWAN serves as a sponsoring partner.

The 20th‑edition CEO WEEK sets a new record for the scale of participating firms in Hong Kong, with 34 listed, pre‑IPO and startup leaders attracting over 100 participants from international venture capital, family offices and top institutional investors. The total assets under management (AUM) of the attending international institutions exceed $20 trillion.

items.title: 〈房產〉捷運宅同站租公寓Vs.大樓租金比較 房仲：亞東醫院站幾無價差
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Comparing Rental Prices of Apartments vs. High-Rise Buildings Near MRT Stations: No Price Gap at Yadong Hospital Station
paras: 租屋族偏好逐捷運而居，但不同住宅產品租金大不同，公寓與大樓價差幅度最大捷運站甚至超過 3 成。永慶房產集團根據租金實價登錄資料，統計近一年雙北捷運站周邊 800 公尺以內公寓與電梯大樓租金。數據顯示，秀朗橋站、景平站的公寓與大樓租金價差幅度最明顯，大樓皆比公寓貴高達 3 成以上。反觀亞東醫院站，大樓、公寓每月每坪租金價差幅度僅 0.2%。

大樓和公寓租金價差幅度最明顯的秀朗橋站、景平站，每坪價差幅度分別為 35.5%、31.9%；若以 20 坪房型為例，每月大樓租金比公寓貴 6,000 元以上。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍分析，兩站周邊公寓產品屋齡普遍較高；近年隨環狀線建設及周邊開發，大樓住宅陸續增加，因此有不少屋齡相對較新的電梯大樓，使兩類住宅的租金水準進一步拉開。值得注意的是，兩站電梯大樓租金總價中位數反而低於公寓，顯示大樓坪數大多比公寓來得小，有意租屋的民眾可視自身需求挑選。

六張犁站則是以價差幅度 28.9%，位居第三。公寓每坪月租 1,665 元、電梯大樓 2,147 元，單坪相差 482 元，若租 20 坪住宅，每月相差高達 9,600 元左右；而新北投站則名列第四。陳金萍表示，六張犁位於大安、信義兩大核心區交界，整體租金基準較高；不過因開發早，周邊以老公寓多，多分布於基隆路以東，電梯大樓屋齡偏新，且多位在更靠近商業中心基隆路以西，使得兩種產品租金差距更加明顯。新北投則因大樓多集中在捷運站周邊、生活機能較完善的路段，公寓則有不少屋齡較高、位置離主要商圈稍遠，因此租金單價也被進一步拉開差距。
反觀價差較小的站點，亞東醫院站公寓每坪月租 1,023 元、電梯大樓 1,026 元，每坪僅差 2 元，價差幅度僅 0.2%；居次則為南京三民站及淡水站，價差幅度分別為 1.8%、2.5%。陳金萍說，亞東醫院站周邊租屋需求主要來自醫療、就業及通勤族群，租客較重視租金負擔、交通便利性與室內空間，建物有無電梯對租金的影響相對有限。
而南京三民站由於區域生活機能成熟，公寓若鄰近捷運、屋況良好或經過整修，即使缺乏電梯，仍可維持一定租金行情，因此，也使兩類產品的租金水準相差不大。淡水站則因舊市區機能完善區域公寓較多，使公寓租金受到支撐；大樓多位於市區相對外圍的區域，即使有電梯優勢，租金仍受位置影響，讓兩者價差有限。
整體而言，陳金萍提醒，大樓通常具備電梯、管理、垃圾代收及門禁等優勢，每坪租金較高，但小坪數產品也可能出現「單價高、總價低」的情況。不過，除了建物型態外，屋齡、位置及捷運站周邊生活圈的發展狀況，都是影響租金的重要因素。此外，目前租金行情尚未強制進行全面實價登錄，實價登錄數據可能與實際市況有所落差，建議租屋族可上租房網站多加比較，或向在地房仲詢問，行情掌握才能更為全面。
paras_en: Renters tend to choose homes near MRT stations, but rental rates vary widely across housing types, with apartments and high‑rise buildings showing the largest gaps—sometimes exceeding 30% at certain stations. Based on actual rental registration data, the Yongqing Real Estate Group analyzed apartments and elevator‑equipped high‑rise rentals within 800 meters of MRT stations in Taipei and New Taipei over the past year. The data show that at Xiulang Bridge and Jingping stations the price gap between apartments and high‑rise buildings is most pronounced, with high‑rises costing more than 30% above apartments. In contrast, at Yadong Hospital station the monthly per‑ping price difference is only 0.2%.

At the stations with the most noticeable gaps—Xiulang Bridge and Jingping—the per‑ping price differences are 35.5% and 31.9% respectively; for a 20‑ping unit, a high‑rise rents over NT$6,000 more per month than an apartment. Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of Yongqing’s research center, explains that apartments near these stations tend to be older, while recent circular‑line construction and surrounding development have added many newer elevator‑equipped high‑rises, widening the rent differential. Notably, the median total rent for high‑rises is actually lower than for apartments, indicating that high‑rise units are generally smaller, so renters can choose based on their space needs.

Liuzhangli station ranks third with a 28.9% gap: apartments rent NT$1,665 per ping, while high‑rise buildings rent NT$2,147, a difference of NT$482 per ping. For a 20‑ping home the monthly gap reaches about NT$9,600. Beitou station ranks fourth. Chen notes that Liuzhangli sits at the junction of the Da’an and Xinyi core districts, where overall rents are high; many older apartments lie east of Keelung Road, while newer high‑rises are west of Keelung Road, closer to the commercial center, amplifying the price gap. At Beitou, most high‑rises cluster near the MRT and well‑served streets, whereas apartments tend to be older and farther from main commercial zones, further widening the rent difference.

Conversely, stations with small gaps show minimal differences. At Yadong Hospital, apartments rent NT$1,023 per ping and high‑rises NT$1,026—just NT$2 apart, a 0.2% gap. The next smallest gaps are at Nanjing Sanmin and Tamsui stations, at 1.8% and 2.5% respectively. Chen says rental demand around Yadong Hospital comes mainly from medical staff, employees and commuters who prioritize affordability, convenience and interior space, so the presence of an elevator has little impact on rent.

At Nanjing Sanmin, the mature local amenities mean that well‑located, well‑maintained apartments— even without elevators—can command comparable rents, keeping the gap small. At Tamsui, many older apartments in the historic downtown area support apartment rents, while high‑rise buildings are situated farther out; despite the elevator advantage, their rents are limited by location, resulting in a modest price difference.

Overall, Chen cautions that high‑rise buildings usually offer elevators, management, trash collection and access control, leading to higher per‑ping rents, but smaller units can exhibit “high unit price, low total price.” Besides building type, age, location and the development of the surrounding MRT‑area lifestyle circle are key rent drivers. Moreover, rental data are not yet fully mandated for comprehensive actual‑price registration, so official figures may differ from market reality. Renters should compare listings on rental websites or consult local agents to get a fuller picture of the market.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉國喬9月營收創新高 外資連3買加持開高攻漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Guojiao September Revenue Hits Record High, Foreign Investors Buy for Third Time Supporting Opening Surge to Upper Limit
paras: 塑化股國喬（1312-TW）受惠進入傳統旺季，9 月營收 41.55 億元、創歷史單月新高，月增 74.5%、年增達 96.81%，加上外資近期已連 3 買進場，激勵今（12）日股價開高後迅速攻上漲停板，盤中成交量爆量增至 8.3 萬張。
累計國喬前9 月營收為 208.24 億元、年增為 30.29%；公司認為，儘管石化產業目前仍面臨高油價、需求承壓及供給過剩等挑戰，但本業營運已有改善，未來將持續強化產品組合與營運效率，加強轉型布局。
國喬今年 8 月也宣布攜手日商 AWI 拓展台灣半導體材料市場，共同入股特殊氣體製造商宏廣新技，藉由 AWI 在工業氣體、產品技術與國際市場的經驗，透過優勢互補，成為國喬連結半導體材料供應鏈的重要布局。
國喬也將於高雄大社廠區新建高純度、高效率氫氣產線，建置太陽能綠能發電系統，以綠電專供氫氣純化製程使用，新產線預計在 2028 年上半年全面試俥量產，挹注營收。
國喬指出，除了本業外，因整體石化產業環境正在改變，未來競爭力不能只建立在傳統石化規模，也將既有製程、材料與產業經驗轉化為新的價值，未來國喬將透過國際合作與策略投資拓展高科技應用，布局相關國際市場。
paras_en: Plastics and chemicals company Guojiao (1312-TW) benefited from entering the traditional peak season, posting September revenue of NT$4.155 billion, a historic monthly high, up 74.5% month‑on‑month and 96.81% year‑on‑year. Foreign investors have bought the stock three consecutive times recently, spurring the share price to open higher on the 12th and quickly surge to the daily limit, with intraday volume exploding to 83,000 contracts.

Cumulative revenue for Guojiao in the first nine months of the year reached NT$20.824 billion, a 30.29% increase year‑on‑year. The company says that although the petrochemical sector still faces challenges such as high oil prices, pressured demand and oversupply, its core operations have improved. Going forward it will continue to strengthen its product mix and operational efficiency and reinforce its transformation strategy.

In August, Guojiao announced a partnership with Japan’s AWI to expand into Taiwan’s semiconductor materials market, jointly investing in specialty gas maker Hongguang New Technology. Leveraging AWI’s expertise in industrial gases, product technology and international markets, the collaboration aims to complement strengths and become a key part of Guojiao’s link to the semiconductor materials supply chain.

Guojiao will also build a new high‑purity, high‑efficiency hydrogen production line at its Dasha plant in Kaohsiung, installing a solar‑powered green energy system to supply electricity exclusively for hydrogen purification. The new line is slated for full trial production in the first half of 2028, which is expected to boost revenue.

Guojiao noted that beyond its core business, the overall petrochemical environment is changing, and future competitiveness cannot rely solely on traditional petrochemical scale. It will convert existing processes, materials and industry experience into new value, and expand high‑tech applications through international cooperation and strategic investments, targeting related overseas markets.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉和碩AI伺服器業務迎秋收 爆量衝漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Wistron AI Server Business Harvests Autumn, Surges to Limit‑Up
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)積極布局 AI 伺服器業務，承接輝達（NVDA-US）GB300 的雲端運算事業群「T1 專案」首批完成出貨，逐步迎來秋收期，並持續朝今年伺服器業績維持 10 倍成長目標前進，激勵和碩今（12）日爆量衝上漲停板。
和碩今天早盤以 95 元跳空開高，盤中衝上漲停板鎖死 98.6 元，一舉站上所有均線。截至 11 點 40 分，排隊委買單超過 9,000 張，成交爆量超過 4.6 萬張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超 1,807 張。
和碩 AI 伺服器開始出貨，加上客戶新手機開賣，帶動 9 月營收衝上 2,147.53 億元，年增逾 8 成，創歷史單月新高；第三季營收也衝上 3,890.26 億元，年增 5 成，為歷史同期新高。和碩持續看好旗下 AI 伺服器展望，預期今年營收占比有機會達到 1 成。
仁寶(2324-TW)布局 AI 伺服器效益也逐步發酵，第四季動能維持強勁，全年伺服器營收同樣有機會達 1 成，今天股價同步走揚，漲逾 2%，收復 5 日線及半年線。
paras_en: Wistron (4938‑TW) is actively expanding its AI server business, having delivered the first batch for Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) GB300 cloud computing “T1 Project.” The company is gradually entering its harvest season and continues to push toward its goal of a ten‑fold increase in server revenue this year, prompting a massive surge that sent the stock to its daily limit up on the 12th.

In early trading today, Wistron opened at NT$95 on a gap up, surged to the limit‑up price of NT$98.6, and locked in that level, climbing above all moving averages. By 11:40 a.m., buy‑order queues exceeded 9,000 lots and trading volume topped 46,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they net‑sold 1,807 lots last week.

Wistron’s AI servers have begun shipping, and the launch of a new customer smartphone boosted September revenue to NT$214.753 billion, up more than 80% year‑over‑year and setting a historic monthly high. Third‑quarter revenue also rose to NT$389.026 billion, a 50% year‑over‑year increase and a record for the same period. The company remains optimistic about its AI server outlook, expecting AI servers to account for about 10% of total revenue this year.

Compal (2324‑TW) is also seeing the benefits of its AI server rollout gradually materialize, with strong momentum carrying into Q4. Full‑year server revenue is likewise projected to reach roughly 10% of total sales, and its stock rose in tandem today, gaining over 2% to reclaim the 5‑day and six‑month moving averages.

items.title_en: How Did Chuanhu and Tai Guangdian Rise? QIC Unveils 500 AI ‘Tomorrow Stars’ Forecasting a Five‑Fold Market‑Cap Growth by 2030
paras: 寬量國際(QIC)今(12)日指出，受惠於美系M9巨頭與AI獨立基礎建設商至2030年龐大資本支出，以及AI強權中唯一強勁淨現金部位的台灣前50大AI龍頭企業(T50)推動供應鏈在地化雙利多效應，看好500家台灣中小AI公司「QIC AI 500」市值於2030年成長5倍，來到2.7兆美元，成為最大贏家。
寬量國際創辦人暨執行長李鴻基指出，AI產業自2023年起已改變台灣資本市場樣貌，有20家20億美元以下的小型股，如川湖(2059-TW)、穎崴(6515-TW)、台光電(2383-TW)，以不到4年時間成為超過百億美元市值及全球AI供應鏈的T50企業，相信在M9資本支出效應帶動下，2030年會有更多T50公司來自目前的QIC AI 500。
根據寬量國際預估，2026至2030年間M9 (Microsoft、Amazon、Google、Meta、Oracle、SpaceX、Tesla、NVIDIA與Apple)以及AI獨立基礎建設商將投入高達6.5兆美元AI資本支出，年複合成長率(CAGR)高達35%，帶動T50企業AI相關營收自2025年1,793億美元成長至2030年的2.15兆美元，CAGR高達64%。
值得注意的是，台灣T50企業總現金部位2026年上半年已來到6.8兆元，年底前更有望突破10兆元大關，其淨現金部位亦創下1.6兆元歷史新高，展現出超越日韓龍頭企業的強健現金流與財務韌性，在供應鏈持續在地化帶動下，QIC AI500必成為全球超大型AI公司主導資本狂潮下，未來真正受益的中小型企業。
根據寬量國際團隊針對台灣「QIC AI 500」所進行的原創研究架構，在深入檢視台灣T50以外共計2,289家上市櫃及興櫃中小市值企業過去12個季度公開財報、法說會與公開資訊後，嚴選出500家實質受惠於AI浪潮的「QIC AI 500」明日之星，其中包含69家市值介於20至100億美元的中型股、227家市值介於3至20億美元的小型股，以及204家市值小於3億美元的微型股。
受惠於全球AI巨頭與T50供應鏈持續在地化雙利多效應，寬量國際預估「QIC AI 500」企業總營收將以18%的CAGR速度成長至2030年的6,650億美元，以「QIC AI 500」企業過去3年平均3.8倍的市值營收比(P/S)計算，「QIC AI 500」企業總市值預計將從目前4,880億美元成長5倍，於2030年達到2.66兆美元。
寬量國際「第20屆QIC CEO WEEK」投資論壇明天起在香港文華東方酒店舉行，向全球資本市場介紹「QIC AI 500」論述，除了10月13至14日實體論壇外，線上論壇則從10月20日起接續登場，共計34家頂尖台灣企業將與全球機構投資人展開深度對談，國家級新創品牌Startup Island TAIWAN則為贊助夥伴。
第20屆QIC CEO WEEK參與企業規模創下香港歷年新高，包括34家上市櫃、Pre-IPO與新創產業領袖，吸引超過100位橫跨國際創投、家族辦公室與頂尖機構投資人參加，與會國際機構投資人管理總資產(AUM)更是超過20兆美元。
paras_en: QIC International (QIC) said today (the 12th) that, thanks to massive capital spending by the US‑based M9 giants and independent AI infrastructure providers through 2030, as well as the dual‑benefit of localising the supply chain driven by Taiwan’s top 50 AI leaders (T50) – the only AI powerhouses with strong net‑cash positions – it expects the market value of 500 Taiwanese small‑ and mid‑cap AI firms in the “QIC AI 500” to grow five‑fold by 2030 to $2.7 trillion, making them the biggest winners.

Founder and CEO of QIC International, Li Hong‑ji, noted that the AI industry has reshaped Taiwan’s capital markets since 2023. Twenty small‑cap stocks under $2 billion – such as Chuanhu (2059‑TW), Ying‑wai (6515‑TW) and Tai Guangdian (2383‑TW) – have become T50 companies with market caps exceeding $100 billion and a role in the global AI supply chain in less than four years. He believes that, propelled by M9 capital‑spending effects, more T50 firms in 2030 will emerge from today’s QIC AI 500.

QIC estimates that between 2026 and 2030 the M9 group (Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta, Oracle, SpaceX, Tesla, NVIDIA and Apple) together with independent AI infrastructure providers will pour up to $6.5 trillion into AI capital spending, at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 35%. This will lift AI‑related revenue of T50 companies from $179.3 billion in 2025 to $2.15 trillion in 2030, a CAGR of 64%.

It is noteworthy that the total cash holdings of Taiwan’s T50 firms reached NT$6.8 trillion in the first half of 2026 and could break the NT$10 trillion threshold by year‑end. Their net‑cash position also hit a historic high of NT$1.6 trillion, showcasing cash‑flow strength and financial resilience that surpasses leading Japanese and Korean peers. With continued localisation of the supply chain, the QIC AI 500 are set to be the true beneficiaries among SMEs as ultra‑large AI companies drive a capital frenzy.

Based on QIC’s original research framework for Taiwan’s “QIC AI 500”, the team examined public filings, earnings calls and disclosures of 2,289 listed, over‑the‑counter and emerging‑board companies outside the T50 over the past 12 quarters. From this they rigorously selected 500 firms that stand to materially benefit from the AI wave – including 69 mid‑caps with market caps of $2‑$10 billion, 227 small‑caps of $300‑$2 billion, and 204 micro‑caps under $300 million.

Benefiting from the twin tailwinds of global AI giants and the ongoing localisation of the T50 supply chain, QIC projects total revenue of the QIC AI 500 to grow at an 18% CAGR to $665 billion by 2030. Using the historical average price‑to‑sales (P/S) multiple of 3.8× from the past three years, the combined market value of the QIC AI 500 is expected to rise five‑fold from the current $488 billion to $2.66 trillion by 2030.

QIC’s 20th‑edition CEO WEEK investment forum kicks off tomorrow at the Mandarin Oriental in Hong Kong, presenting the “QIC AI 500” thesis to global capital markets. In addition to the in‑person sessions on October 13‑14, an online forum will run from October 20 onward, featuring 34 leading Taiwanese companies in deep dialogues with global institutional investors. The national‑level startup brand Startup Island TAIWAN serves as a sponsoring partner.

The 20th‑edition CEO WEEK sets a new record for the scale of participating firms in Hong Kong, with 34 listed, pre‑IPO and startup leaders attracting over 100 participants from international venture capital, family offices and top institutional investors. The total assets under management (AUM) of the attending international institutions exceed $20 trillion.

items.title: 宏達電《羽火共舞》正式登上國家兩廳院 作品巡演橫跨巴黎、上海、倫敦、台北、紐約與香港
items.title_en: HTC's "Playing with Fire" XR Concert Officially Debuts at Taiwan's National Theater and Concert Hall
paras: 全球智慧型手機與虛擬實境平台和生態系統創新設計領導者宏達電(2498-TW)，今（12）日宣布，旗下致力推動科技與藝術融合的 VIVE Arts，與國際沉浸式敘事製作公司 Atlas V 共同製作的王羽佳 XR 音樂會《羽火共舞》（Playing with Fire: An Immersive Odyssey with Yuja Wang），現正式登上國家兩廳院實驗劇場，台北場演出將持續至 10 月 24 日。作品自巴黎愛樂廳首演後獲得廣大迴響，隨即展開國際巡演，陸續於上海、倫敦登場，未來亦將前往紐約與香港。
從觀眾席走進演奏現場　重新拉近觀眾與演奏者距離
王羽佳以極具辨識度的演奏風格與舞台魅力享譽國際，其快速而細膩的演奏動作，即使在傳統音樂會現場，也不容易從單一觀看角度完整捕捉。《羽火共舞》透過沉浸式科技突破舞台與觀眾席之間的距離，讓觀眾能自由環繞王羽佳的虛擬身影，從不同視角近距離觀看她的演奏姿態、觸鍵與神情，捕捉一般音樂會現場難以看見的細節。
更特別的是，展演現場配置史坦威鋼琴（Steinway & Sons Spirio ） 高解析自動演奏鋼琴，精準重現王羽佳演奏時的觸鍵、力度與速度，並與虛擬影像及聲音同步「共演」。當王羽佳在觀眾眼前彈奏，實體鋼琴琴鍵也隨之起伏，讓數位影像、真實樂器與聲音在同一空間交會，形成不同於傳統音樂會的觀看與聆聽體驗。
「藉由這項嶄新的沉浸式創作，讓藝術與科技交會融合，對我而言無疑是夢想成真的時刻。」《羽火共舞》也是一次重新思考音樂如何與觀眾建立連結的創作嘗試，透過音樂、視覺與混合實境的結合，讓演奏不只被聆聽，也能以更貼近、更具空間感的方式被感受。
曾體驗作品測試版本的政治大學傳播學院特聘教授林日璇表示：「如此流暢的整合，非常不容易。」臺北藝術大學藝術與科技中心主任王俊傑則形容：「這是虛擬與真實的完美疊合。」
九首經典樂曲交織音樂、視覺與聲音　走進《羽火共舞》的創作世界
《羽火共舞》全作以「火」為核心意象，王羽佳親自挑選 9 首經典鋼琴作品，包括史特拉汶斯基《火鳥》所代表的創造之火、李斯特《鬼火》的魅惑之火、德布西《月光》的暖心之火，以及普羅高菲夫《戰爭奏鳴曲》的毀滅之火。
作品由導演皮耶-阿蘭．傑羅（Pierre-Alain Giraud）執導，並結合藝術家嘉布里艾拉．弗莉翠克斯多蒂（Gabríela Friðriksdóttir）的視覺創作，以及尼可拉斯．貝克（Nicolas Becker）等人的聲音設計，將王羽佳的演奏從音樂延伸至影像、聲音與空間，讓不同曲目的情緒與意象在沉浸式環境中被進一步放大。
VIVE Arts 總監葉心宇表示：「《羽火共舞》最特別的地方，在於科技並不是附加在音樂之外，而是成為整個藝術體驗的一部分。觀眾可以真正改變自己觀看演奏的位置與距離，用過去音樂會中無法做到的方式感受藝術家的演奏。我們很高興作品這次正式來到國家兩廳院，讓台灣觀眾親身走進王羽佳的音樂世界。」
從巴黎走向全球　《羽火共舞》持續於國際舞台巡演
《羽火共舞》入圍 2026 年坎城影展沉浸式競賽單元，並持續於全球重要文化與表演藝術場域巡演。繼上海、倫敦與台北後，作品亦將前往紐約與香港與觀眾見面。
自 2016 年成立以來，VIVE Arts 持續與全球藝術家、美術館及文化機構合作，運用 VR、AR、XR、人工智慧及沉浸式科技，探索藝術創作、文化內容與觀眾體驗的新可能。透過《羽火共舞》等作品，VIVE Arts 持續推動科技進一步成為藝術創作與敘事的一部分，拓展藝術與科技融合的更多可能。
paras_en: HTC (2498-TW), a global leader in innovative design for smartphones and virtual reality platforms and ecosystems, announced today (the 12th) that its VIVE Arts division, which promotes the fusion of technology and art, and international immersive storytelling company Atlas V have co-produced pianist Yuja Wang's XR concert "Playing with Fire: An Immersive Odyssey with Yuja Wang," now officially staged at the National Theater and Concert Hall Experimental Theater, with the Taipei run continuing through October 24. After a resonant premiere at Paris' Philharmonie, the work launched an international tour, appearing in Shanghai and London and slated for New York and Hong Kong.
Walking from the audience seats onto the performance space re‑bridges the gap between listeners and musicians

Yuja Wang is internationally renowned for her distinctive playing style and stage charisma; her rapid yet nuanced gestures are hard to capture from a single viewpoint even in a traditional concert hall. "Playing with Fire" uses immersive technology to dissolve the distance between stage and audience, allowing viewers to freely circle Wang's virtual avatar and observe her technique, key presses and expressions from multiple close‑up angles, revealing details rarely seen in conventional concerts.

A special feature of the show is the inclusion of a Steinway & Sons Spirio high‑resolution player piano, which precisely reproduces Wang's key touches, dynamics and speed, synchronizing with the virtual imagery and sound for a joint performance. As Wang plays before the audience, the physical piano keys move in tandem, merging digital visuals, a real instrument and live audio in one space for a viewing and listening experience unlike any traditional concert.

"This brand‑new immersive creation, where art and technology intersect, is truly a dream‑come‑true moment for me," said Wang. "Playing with Fire" also represents a fresh exploration of how music can connect with audiences, combining sound, visuals and mixed reality so that the performance is not only heard but felt in a more immediate, spatial way.

Professor Lin Rixuan, a distinguished faculty member of the College of Communication at National Chengchi University who tested an early version of the work, said, "Such seamless integration is extremely difficult to achieve." Wang Junjie, director of the Arts and Technology Center at Taipei University of the Arts, described it as "a perfect overlay of virtual and real."
Nine classic pieces intertwine music, visuals and sound, inviting audiences into the creative world of "Playing with Fire"

The concert centers on the motif of fire, with Wang personally selecting nine classic piano works—including Stravinsky’s "The Firebird" representing creative fire, Liszt’s "Eternal Fire" for seductive fire, Debussy’s "Clair de Lune" as warm fire, and Prokofiev’s "War Sonata" embodying destructive fire.

Directed by Pierre‑Alain Giraud, the production incorporates visual art by Gabríela Friðriksdóttir and sound design by Nicolas Becker and others, extending Wang’s performance beyond music into imagery, sound and space, amplifying each piece’s emotion and imagery within the immersive environment.

VIVE Arts director Yeh Hsin‑Yu said, "The most special aspect of 'Playing with Fire' is that technology is not an add‑on to the music; it becomes part of the entire artistic experience. Audiences can truly change their viewing position and distance, experiencing the performance in ways impossible in traditional concerts. We are thrilled the work is now officially at the National Theater and Concert Hall, allowing Taiwanese audiences to step into Yuja Wang’s musical world."
From Paris to the world, "Playing with Fire" continues its international tour

The concert has been selected for the immersive competition section of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival and will keep touring major cultural and performing‑arts venues worldwide. After Shanghai, London and Taipei, it will also appear in New York and Hong Kong.

Since its founding in 2016, VIVE Arts has continuously collaborated with artists, museums and cultural institutions worldwide, employing VR, AR, XR, artificial intelligence and immersive technologies to explore new possibilities for artistic creation, cultural content and audience experience. Through works like "Playing with Fire," VIVE Arts keeps advancing technology as an integral part of artistic storytelling, expanding the horizons of art‑tech integration.

items.title_en: Micron Beats Apple in Quarterly Earnings! Memory Shortage Gives Chip Supplier Pricing Power
paras: 記憶體短缺正改變科技業的獲利版圖。美光(MU-US) 截至9月30日的第四財季淨利達377億美元，超過蘋果(AAPL-US) 同期的298億美元，單季多賺約80億美元。當蘋果仍需採購晶片，美光卻無法滿足客戶需求，供需失衡讓美光掌握定價權，也使蘋果面臨毛利率下滑壓力。
市場策略師Charlie Bilello在X平台以三句話概括這項轉變：「蘋果需要晶片。美光有晶片。美光決定價格。」
他指出，美光淨利在短短兩年間暴增42倍至約380億美元，比蘋果上一季還多約80億美元，並直言：「我們從未見過這樣的定價權。」
美光獲利快速攀升，也反映在每股獲利上。2024財年，美光標準化每股獲利僅1.30美元，2026財年已升至75.52美元。涵蓋2027財年的35位分析師預估，每股獲利將進一步達到176.15美元，較前一年再增逾一倍。
美光預估，2027財年第一季營收將達615億美元，高於剛公布的542億美元。Ritholtz Wealth Management執行長Josh Brown評論，美光的業績指引不僅未遭下修，反而持續上調。
美光執行長Sanjay Mehrotra接受CNBC訪問時則表示：「事實上，我們根本無法滿足客戶需求。」
供應商的定價優勢，正轉化為客戶的成本負擔。蘋果毛利率曾從2021財年的41.8%，逐年攀升至2025財年的46.9%，但過去累積的緩衝空間，如今正受到記憶體漲價侵蝕。
排除關稅退款影響後，蘋果毛利率由3月當季的49.3%，降至6月當季的48.1%，並預估9月當季將進一步降至約46.5%。
蘋果管理層明確指出，記憶體成本是6月當季毛利率下滑的主要原因，也將持續拖累9月當季表現，先前囤積庫存帶來的緩衝效果則將在9月後逐步消退。
蘋果前執行長庫克在7月財報電話會議上，曾將記憶體價格上漲形容為「百年一遇的洪水」，凸顯成本壓力之大。
面臨衝擊的不只蘋果。Egerton Capital共同創辦人John Armitage在Podcast節目《In Good Company》中指出，記憶體成本通膨及其對物料成本的影響，也是輝達面臨的一大問題。不過，輝達擁有75%的毛利率，吸收成本衝擊的空間遠大於蘋果。
即使獲利大幅躍升，市場仍對美光的成長延續性抱持疑慮。目前美光預估本益比為5.9倍，遠低於三年平均的10.5倍，反映投資人對這波超級循環能維持多久仍有疑問。
根據TIKR分析，只要需求持續超過供給，美光的定價權就不會消失。
供給端另有勞資爭議變數。據路透報導，美光台灣桃園工廠工會有1,994名成員、占投票人數99%，因獎金糾紛投票授權罷工。
台灣是美光DRAM與HBM的重要生產基地，但工會強調，授權並不代表立即罷工，具體時間與細節仍在討論。若實際停工，可能進一步收緊供給，加重蘋果的記憶體採購壓力。
蘋果預計10月23日發售首款摺疊螢幕手機iPhone Duo，售價1,999美元，或有助將部分成本轉嫁給消費者，但現有財測顯示，蘋果仍在自行吸收這筆開銷。
隨著下一份財報預計於10月下旬公布，記憶體成本是否持續攀升，將成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: Memory shortages are reshaping the profit landscape of the tech industry. Micron (MU-US) posted a net profit of $37.7 billion for its fourth fiscal quarter ending September 30, surpassing Apple’s (AAPL-US) $29.8 billion for the same period by about $8 billion. While Apple still needs to purchase chips, Micron cannot meet all customer demand, creating a supply‑demand imbalance that gives Micron pricing power and puts pressure on Apple’s gross margin.
Market strategist Charlie Bilello summed up the shift in three sentences on X: “Apple needs chips. Micron has chips. Micron sets the price.”

He noted that Micron’s net profit has exploded 42‑fold in just two years to roughly $38 billion—about $8 billion more than Apple earned in the previous quarter—and said, “We’ve never seen pricing power like this.”

Micron’s profit surge is also reflected in earnings per share. For fiscal 2024, Micron reported a standardized EPS of $1.30, which rose to $75.52 for fiscal 2026. Thirty‑five analysts covering fiscal 2027 project EPS to climb further to $176.15, more than double the prior year’s level.

Micron forecasts first‑quarter revenue of $61.5 billion for fiscal 2027, above the recently announced $54.2 billion. Josh Brown, CEO of Ritholtz Wealth Management, commented that Micron’s guidance has not only avoided cuts but continues to be raised.
In a CNBC interview, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said, “The fact is, we simply cannot satisfy customer demand.”

The supplier’s pricing advantage is turning into a cost burden for customers. Apple’s gross margin rose from 41.8% in fiscal 2021 to 46.9% in fiscal 2025, but the buffer built up over the years is now being eroded by rising memory prices.
Excluding tariff refunds, Apple’s gross margin fell from 49.3% in the March quarter to 48.1% in the June quarter, and it is projected to drop further to about 46.5% in the September quarter.

Apple’s management explicitly said that memory costs were the main driver of the June‑quarter margin decline and will continue to drag down September‑quarter performance, while the cushioning effect of previously stockpiled inventory will gradually disappear after September.
Former Apple CEO Tim Cook described the surge in memory prices during the July earnings call as a “once‑in‑a‑century flood,” underscoring the magnitude of the cost pressure.

The impact is not limited to Apple. John Armitage, co‑founder of Egerton Capital, noted on the podcast “In Good Company” that memory‑cost inflation and its effect on material costs are also a major issue for Nvidia. However, Nvidia’s 75% gross margin gives it far more room to absorb cost shocks than Apple does.

Even with the profit jump, the market remains skeptical about Micron’s growth sustainability. Micron’s current forward P/E is 5.9×, well below its three‑year average of 10.5×, reflecting investor doubts about how long this super‑cycle can last.
According to TIKR analysis, as long as demand continues to outpace supply, Micron’s pricing power will not disappear.

On the supply side, labor‑relations issues add uncertainty. Reuters reported that the union at Micron’s Taoyuan, Taiwan plant, representing 1,994 members (99% of voters), voted to authorize a strike over a bonus dispute.

Taiwan is a key production hub for Micron’s DRAM and HBM, but the union stressed that authorization does not mean an immediate strike; timing and details are still being discussed. If a shutdown occurs, supply could tighten further, increasing pressure on Apple’s memory procurement.

Apple plans to launch its first foldable‑screen phone, the iPhone Duo, on October 23 at a price of $1,999, which could help shift some costs to consumers. However, current financial forecasts show Apple is still absorbing the expense itself.
With the next earnings report expected in late October, whether memory costs continue to rise will be a focal point for the market.

items.title: 亞馬遜傳砸70億美元收購AI新創Decart！搶攻AI晶片切換技術、強化算力布局
items.title_en: Amazon Plans $7 B Acquisition of AI Startup Decart to Boost Chip Switching Tech and Compute Power
paras: 據知情人士透露，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 正洽談收購人工智慧（AI）新創公司Decart，交易估值可能達到約70億美元。若交易順利完成，將進一步擴大亞馬遜在AI運算領域的布局，尤其Decart開發的軟體可協助開發者在不同AI晶片之間切換，隨著科技業競相爭奪運算資源，相關技術的重要性也日益提升。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，總部位於舊金山的Decart，其技術可降低開發者轉換不同AI晶片的難度。知情人士表示，若雙方談判未破局，也沒有其他潛在買家加入競爭，交易可能很快敲定。
根據PitchBook資料，Decart已從創投投資人募得超過4億美元，投資者包括紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）、Benchmark及Radical Ventures。今年5月，該公司的估值接近40億美元。
Decart於2023年由3名以色列工程師創立，分別為兄弟檔Dean Leitersdorf與Orian Leitersdorf，以及Moshe Shalev。
此外，該公司也正在開發名為Lucy與Oasis的世界模型（world models）。這類模型能夠生成並模擬真實世界的3D環境。
與此同時，亞馬遜正積極發展自研AI晶片Trainium3，與目前仍主導圖形處理器（GPU）市場的輝達(NVDA-US) 競爭。
GPU是支撐當前AI熱潮的重要硬體，隨著AI模型訓練與推論需求攀升，晶片供應及運算效率成為科技業競爭的關鍵。
根據《華爾街日報》先前報導，亞馬遜旗下雲端服務部門AWS於2025年與Decart接觸後，對其創辦團隊留下深刻印象，並讓Decart提前取得Trainium3晶片的使用權。
亞馬遜近年持續透過大型收購擴展業務版圖。2022年，亞馬遜以65億美元收購美高梅電影公司（MGM）。
今年稍早，亞馬遜也宣布以約110億美元收購Globalstar。 Globalstar被視為SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下星鏈（Starlink）的競爭對手之一。
以色列媒體Calcalist本月稍早亦報導，Decart正與一家大型科技公司進行深入的出售談判。
paras_en: According to sources, Amazon (AMZN-US) is in talks to acquire AI startup Decart in a deal that could be valued at about $7 billion. If completed, the purchase would further expand Amazon’s AI computing footprint, especially as Decart’s software helps developers switch between different AI chips, a capability growing in importance as tech firms vie for compute resources.

The Wall Street Journal reports that San‑Francisco‑based Decart has technology that reduces the difficulty for developers to transition between AI chips. Sources say that if negotiations stay on track and no other bidders emerge, the deal could be sealed quickly.

PitchBook data shows Decart has raised over $400 million from venture investors, including Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Radical Ventures. In May this year the company was valued at nearly $4 billion.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers: brothers Dean Leitersdorf and Orian Leitersdorf, along with Moshe Shalev.
The company is also developing world models called Lucy and Oasis, which can generate and simulate realistic 3D environments.
At the same time, Amazon is actively developing its own AI chip, Trainium 3, to compete with Nvidia (NVDA-US), which still dominates the GPU market.

GPUs are the key hardware powering the current AI boom, and as demand for model training and inference climbs, chip supply and compute efficiency have become critical competitive factors for the tech industry.
A previous Wall Street Journal report noted that after AWS first contacted Decart in 2025, the cloud unit was impressed by the founding team and gave Decart early access to Trainium 3 chips.
Amazon has been expanding its business through large acquisitions in recent years. In 2022 it bought MGM for $6.5 billion.
Earlier this year Amazon announced a roughly $11 billion acquisition of Globalstar, which is seen as a competitor to SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) Starlink satellite network.
Israeli media outlet Calcalist reported earlier this month that Decart is in deep sale negotiations with a major technology company.

items.title: 美50年數據敲警鐘：AI恐持續擠壓勞動所得  生產力與勞動份額持續分化
items.title_en: U.S. 50-Year Data Sounds Alarm: AI May Keep Squeezing Labor Income as Productivity and Labor Share Diverge
paras: AI浪潮之下，市場普遍擔憂技術迭代會進一步壓低勞工在國民所得中的分配佔比，美國過去五十年的生產力與薪資數據則為此討論提供關鍵參考。
數據顯示，美國企業每小時實際產出已較1973年翻倍，但勞工實際時薪漲幅並未同步。企業產出中的勞動份額，從1973年約63%下滑至2025年約55%，近期美國國民經濟核算修訂並未扭轉此一格局。
根據瑞銀分析，本次收入上調主要來自利息收入，勞動收入上調幅度有限，總量改善不等於勞工購買力同步提升。
需要釐清的是，生產力與實際薪酬採用兩套不同價格統計口徑。生產率使用企業產出價格折算，實際時薪依據CPI調整，兩組數據差值不能全部歸因為勞動收入轉移到資本。在2000年之前，統計口徑差異能解釋大部分差距，2000年後，勞動份額本身下檔成為主導因素。即便勞工實際報酬持續成長，其在總產出中佔比仍可能走低。勞動份額之外產出還需涵蓋資本折舊、利息與稅費，勞動佔比下滑幅度不等於企業利潤擴張幅度。

根據高盛上月對商業部門拆解的報告，勞動份額較1990年代平均值下降約7.5個百分點。該行估算，約四成降幅來自統計與分類偏差，並非真實所得分配轉移。一方面，1986年美國稅改推動企業改用穿透型組織架構，部分薪資收入計入企業利潤，直接壓低統計層面勞動份額。另一方面，電腦、軟體等短週期資產佔比提升推高折舊開支；勞動份額分母包含折舊，也會拉低佔比，不代表資本所有者獲得等額淨收益。同時股權激勵存在計算缺口，部分選擇權收益未能納入薪資統計，造成勞動報酬被低估。
剔除統計擾動後，剩餘約六成、接近4.5個百分點的降幅屬於真實分配變化。高盛認為，企業加價能力提升、自動化普及、勞動者議價能力走弱是核心驅動，三者交織難以單獨量化。市佔率向用工規模較小的「超級企業」集中，進一步拉低整體勞動份額；製造業機器人滲透率較高的行業，勞動份額降幅更明顯，工會力量弱化也削弱勞工議價能力。
對於AI帶來的影響，高盛提出關鍵判斷：勞動份額能否企穩，取決於AI替代勞工任務的速度與創造新職位的速度孰快孰慢。若任務替代持續快於崗位創造，勞動收入佔比或將進一步承壓。
短期經濟數據來看，根據瑞銀測算，2026年第二季美國非農業商業生產力年增2.3%，單位勞動成本成長2.2%，未見生產力大幅躍升，同期實質薪資收入年增0.8%，低於實質消費支出2.5%的成長速度；個人儲蓄率雖小幅上修至4.4%，仍低於一年前水準。科技變革的長期紅利如何更公平惠及勞工，仍是宏觀經濟需要直面的核心命題。
paras_en: Amid the AI wave, markets broadly worry that rapid technological iteration will further depress the share of national income that goes to workers. The United States’ productivity and wage data over the past fifty years provide a crucial reference for this debate.

The data show that U.S. firms’ real output per hour has doubled since 1973, but workers’ real hourly wages have not kept pace. The labor share of corporate output fell from about 63% in 1973 to roughly 55% in 2025, and recent revisions to the national accounts have not reversed this trend.

According to UBS analysis, the recent rise in total income comes mainly from higher interest earnings, while the increase in labor income is modest; a rise in aggregate income does not translate into an equivalent boost in workers’ purchasing power.

It is important to note that productivity and real compensation are measured using two different price bases. Productivity is valued at firm‑output prices, whereas real hourly wages are CPI‑adjusted. The gap between the two series cannot be fully attributed to a shift of labor income to capital. Before 2000, most of the divergence can be explained by the statistical‑definition difference; after 2000, a genuine decline in the labor share becomes the dominant factor. Even if workers’ real compensation keeps growing, its proportion of total output can still fall. The labor share’s denominator also includes capital depreciation, interest and taxes, so a drop in the labor share does not equal the magnitude of profit expansion.

Based on Goldman Sachs’ latest sector‑level report, the labor share is about 7.5 percentage points lower than its 1990s average. The bank estimates that roughly 40% of that decline stems from statistical and classification biases rather than a real shift in income distribution. One source is the 1986 U.S. tax reform that encouraged firms to adopt pass‑through structures, causing part of payroll to be recorded as corporate profit and thus lowering the reported labor share. Another is the rising share of short‑life assets such as computers and software, which raises depreciation expense; because depreciation is part of the labor‑share denominator, the share falls even though capital owners do not necessarily earn an equivalent net gain. In addition, gaps in equity‑compensation accounting mean that some stock‑option gains are omitted from wage statistics, further understating labor compensation.

After stripping out statistical distortions, about 60% of the decline—or roughly 4.5 percentage points—reflects a genuine redistribution. Goldman Sachs attributes this to three intertwined forces: firms’ growing pricing power, the spread of automation, and weakening bargaining power of workers. The effect is hard to isolate quantitatively. Market share is concentrating in “super‑large” firms that employ fewer workers per unit of output, pulling the overall labor share down; industries with high robot penetration, especially manufacturing, see an even sharper drop, and the erosion of union strength further weakens workers’ negotiating leverage.

Regarding AI’s impact, Goldman Sachs offers a key judgment: whether the labor share can stabilize depends on whether AI’s speed of substituting labor tasks outpaces the speed of creating new jobs. If task substitution continues to outstrip job creation, the labor‑income share will face additional pressure.

Short‑term data show that, according to UBS estimates, U.S. non‑farm business productivity grew 2.3% year‑over‑year in Q2 2026 and unit labor costs rose 2.2%, indicating no sharp productivity jump. Real hourly wages rose 0.8% year‑over‑year, lagging behind the 2.5% growth in real consumer spending. The personal savings rate was nudged up to 4.4% but remains below last year’s level. How the long‑run gains from technological change can be shared more equitably with workers remains a core macro‑economic challenge.

items.title: AI舉債熱潮降溫 9月全球發行量腰斬、投資人重估風險
items.title_en: AI Debt Boom Wanes as September Global Issuance Halved, Investors Reassess Risk
paras: 經歷數月大規模舉債後，投資人開始重新評估人工智慧（AI）產業風險，科技企業為AI專案籌資所發行的新債，9月明顯降溫。
摩根士丹利(MS-US) 統計公開債券與私募配售交易，9月全球AI相關債務發行規模降至230億美元，不到8月的一半；自6月創下1130億美元歷史高峰後，新增融資持續回落。企業當時發債，主要為資料中心、晶片等AI關鍵基礎設施籌資。
摩根士丹利指出，發債量下滑，首先是企業今年稍早已完成大規模舉債；投資人也愈來愈關注龐大投資能否長期帶來回報，以及美國資料中心建設面臨的民間與政治阻力。1至8月，美國大型科技企業在美國投資等級債券市場累計發債約3060億美元，9月AI相關債券發行幾乎停滯。
摩根士丹利數據顯示，2026年至今企業已發行約4660億美元AI相關債務，去年同期為1010億美元。大量新增供給讓信貸投資人得以要求部分專案提供較高收益率，也推升大型雲端服務業者借貸成本。投資人同時審慎看待企業攀升的債務負擔，以及前景仍不明朗的資本支出需求。
市場情緒轉變之際，數筆用於購買先進AI晶片的大型融資交易即將登場。華爾街銀行正為博通(AVGO-US) 與Anthropic籌組600億美元融資；SpaceX(SPCX-US) 也在洽談籌集400億美元，以採購輝達(NVDA-US) 晶片。兩筆交易預計未來數月透過銀團方式分銷給廣泛投資人。
美國各地資料中心計畫接連遭居民反對，民眾憂心高耗能設施影響供水與空氣品質。甲骨文(ORCL-US) 位於新墨西哥州的「木星計畫」園區因難以接入電力而成為焦點。
甲骨文已發出不可抗力通知，約180億美元配套貸款壓力因此加大。知情交易人士透露，近期這類貸款在私下交易市場的價格約為面額的85美分。
Monarch Alternative Capital董事總經理暨歐洲信貸主管Jordan Rieger表示，近期融資放緩讓信貸投資人有機會重新評估信用風險與融資工具架構。他形容，市場彷彿「一邊開火車，一邊鋪設鐵軌」，希望列車不會在釀成嚴重後果前脫軌。
困境債務機構波盧斯資本（Polus Capital）首席投資長Rob Dafforn指出，市場充斥投機性高、槓桿沉重的交易，部分投資人已付出過高成本。融資成本偏高，加上專案回報時程與收益曲線不確定，使他難以判斷價值將落在產業鏈哪個環節。
該機構已開始梳理AI融資交易網絡，但尚未實際投資。
paras_en: After months of large-scale borrowing, investors have begun to reassess the risks of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, and the new debt issued by tech companies to fund AI projects cooled noticeably in September.

Morgan Stanley (MS-US) statistics on public bonds and private placements show that global AI-related debt issuance fell to $23 billion in September, less than half of August’s level; since hitting a record high of $113 billion in June, new financing has continued to decline. At that time, companies issued debt mainly to fund AI-critical infrastructure such as data centers and chips.

Morgan Stanley noted that the drop in issuance is partly because companies had already completed large borrowings earlier this year, and investors are increasingly concerned about whether massive investments can yield long-term returns, as well as the private and political resistance facing U.S. data center construction. From January to August, U.S. large technology firms issued about $306 billion in investment-grade bonds, while AI-related bond issuance in September almost stalled.

Morgan Stanley data shows that from 2026 to now, companies have issued about $466 billion in AI-related debt, compared with $101 billion in the same period last year. The large influx of new supply has allowed credit investors to demand higher yields on certain projects, also driving up borrowing costs for large cloud service providers. Investors are also cautious about companies’ rising debt burdens and the still uncertain capital expenditure needs.

During this shift in market sentiment, several large financing deals aimed at purchasing advanced AI chips are set to surface. Wall Street banks are arranging $60 billion of financing for Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Anthropic; SpaceX (SPCX-US) is also negotiating to raise $40 billion to purchase NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips. Both deals are expected to be distributed to a wide range of investors through syndication in the coming months.

Data center projects across the United States have repeatedly faced local opposition, as residents worry that high‑energy facilities will affect water supply and air quality. Oracle (ORCL-US)’s “Jupiter Project” campus in New Mexico has become a focal point due to difficulties in accessing power.

Oracle has issued a force majeure notice, increasing the pressure on the roughly $18 billion in related loans. An informed trader disclosed that recently such loans are trading in the private market at about 85 cents on the dollar face value.

Jordan Rieger, Managing Director and Head of European Credit at Monarch Alternative Capital, said the recent slowdown in financing gives credit investors an opportunity to reassess credit risk and financing structure. He described the market as “like a train that’s both running and laying tracks,” hoping the train won’t derail before serious consequences arise.

Rob Dafforn, Chief Investment Officer of Polus Capital, a distressed debt firm, pointed out that the market is saturated with speculative, highly leveraged deals, and some investors have already paid too high a cost. With high financing costs and uncertain project return timelines and yield curves, he finds it difficult to determine where value will land in the industry chain.
Polus Capital has begun mapping the AI financing transaction network, but has not yet made any actual investments.

items.title: AZIO德州簽資料中心供電合約 商機上看4.5億美元
items.title_en: AZIO Signs Power Supply Contract for Texas Data Center, Opportunity Seen at $450 Million
paras: 2026年10月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國AI基礎建設業者AZIO AI Holdings(AZIO-US)近日宣布，旗下德州Atlas One資料中心與Power Champion簽署電力及託管服務合約，初期提供10MW電力容量，客戶未來可選擇再增加40MW，使合約規模最高擴大至50MW。若全部容量完成交付並持續收費五年，AZIO的潛在固定收入最高可達4.5億美元。
根據合約，目前正式簽約的10MW容量，每月可收取150萬美元固定費用，五年合計約9,000萬美元。這筆費用相當於客戶預訂10MW供電容量，即使沒有全部使用，仍須依約支付。此外，實際用電量另按每度0.13美元計費。
AZIO表示，Atlas One的變電站及配電設施尚未完工，客戶也須取得GPU進口與部署許可，因此10MW容量尚未正式交付，開始收費的時間仍未確定。公司必須先完成相關工程並交付約定容量，才能開始依合約收費。

paras_en: October 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. AI infrastructure provider AZIO AI Holdings (AZIO-US) announced that its Texas Atlas One data center has signed a power and hosting services agreement with Power Champion, initially providing 10 MW of power capacity, with customers able to add another 40 MW later, expanding the contract size up to a maximum of 50 MW. If the full capacity is delivered and billed over five years, AZIO’s potential fixed revenue could reach up to $450 million.

According to the contract, the formally signed 10 MW capacity will generate a fixed fee of $1.5 million per month, amounting to about $90 million over five years.
