items.title: 高盛示警美股暗藏風險！標普500「只剩一筆AI交易」、六分之一成分股重挫逾50%
paras: 美股指數持續攀高，市場內部卻出現愈來愈明顯的分歧。高盛指出，當前美股漲勢高度依賴人工智慧（AI）題材，少數科技股不斷推升大盤，但愈來愈多個股已大幅偏離指數表現。高盛避險基金業務主管Tony Pasquariello坦言，當前市場「基本上只是一筆大型交易」，核心就是AI，且他不再像先前一樣有把握認定美股未來仍有5%的上漲空間。
高盛數據顯示，標普500指數成分股中，約六分之一的股價已較高點回落超過50%，但大盤本身仍接近歷史新高。
隨著美債殖利率走高、股市漲勢集中於少數大型科技股，以及企業獲利成長愈來愈仰賴AI相關需求，市場正面臨多重壓力。
接下來的財報季，輝達(NVDA-US) 與美光科技(MU-US) 能否交出符合甚至超越市場預期的成績，將成為多頭行情的重要考驗。

美股漲勢高度集中，45%標普500成分股與大盤走勢背離

標普500指數上週一度攀抵7,818點的歷史新高，但隨後受到OpenAI營收預警消息影響，回落至7,765點。儘管指數仍處高檔，市場內部的強弱分化卻持續擴大。
高盛數據顯示，過去3個月，標普500指數約45%的成分股與大盤呈現負相關，比例創下歷史新高。
高盛另一項分析則顯示，自8月27日以來，標普500指數累計上漲1.28%，但剔除AI相關股票後的指數下跌5.19%，兩者近30個交易日的表現差距，已接近2023年1月AI交易行情啟動以來的最大水準。
小型股同樣承壓。羅素2000指數過去20個交易日中，有16個交易日表現落後那斯達克指數，累計落後幅度約9個百分點。
Pasquariello形容，當前美股是一場「極度狹窄的上漲行情」，大型科技股持續扮演推升指數的火車頭，但對利率較敏感的產業及景氣循環股，卻持續面臨壓力。

避險基金整體持股偏低　資金卻高度集中半導體

值得注意的是，儘管美股接近歷史高點，機構投資人的整體股票曝險並未同步攀升。
高盛Prime Book數據顯示，避險基金9月的美股淨曝險降至過去1年、3年及5年的低檔區間。基本面多空策略的淨槓桿率也連續3週下滑，降至川普去年公布對等關稅措施以來的最低水準，高盛情緒指標則徘徊在多年低點附近。
Pasquariello認為，市場普遍低配美股本身，反而可能形成另一種擁擠交易。對擔心錯過標普500進一步上攻8,100點的機構而言，看漲選擇權的相對成本不高，也可能成為追價工具。
然而，整體淨曝險偏低，不代表市場風險較小，因為資金仍高度集中在少數科技股。
高盛數據顯示，9月科技股是避險基金唯一淨買超的產業，買進規模更創2025年2月以來新高。所謂「科技七巨頭」的淨曝險，目前約占美股總曝險的22%，創2022年初有紀錄以來新高；半導體持倉占比則達12%，較年初翻倍。
此外，槓桿型半導體ETF資產規模已達約1,150億美元，若市場轉跌，槓桿機制可能進一步放大價格波動。
OpenAI相關消息衝擊市場後，高盛科技、媒體與電信（TMT）交易部門上週四在半導體、AI及大型科技股方向出現逾10億美元淨賣出，也顯示資金集中所帶來的波動風險已開始浮現。

標普500獲利成長仰賴少數企業　輝達、美光成關鍵

美股多頭仍有一項重要支撐，就是企業獲利表現。
Pasquariello指出，市場預期標普500企業獲利年增率達28%，高於前一週預估的27%，在企業獲利前景持續上修的情況下，做空美股並不容易。
但若進一步拆解獲利結構，就會發現成長動能同樣高度集中。
高盛分析師Ben Snider的第三季財報預覽顯示，標普500成分股中位數企業的獲利成長率，預計將從第二季的14%放緩至第三季的9%。相較之下，科技業獲利成長率預估高達64%，能源業更達122%。
高盛分析師Wilson的估算則顯示，本季標普500獲利成長貢獻中，前10大企業將占68%，高於上一季的48%。其中，光是美光與輝達兩家公司，就占前述獲利成長貢獻的一半。
此外，高盛預估，標普500全年獲利成長率將達27%，但這已是該行模型所預期的本輪景氣循環高點，之後3季成長速度可能逐季放緩。
與此同時，大型雲端服務業者的資本支出成長率，據Snider估計可能達116%，也可能在本季觸頂。
如果企業獲利成長與AI資本支出同步見頂，而相關股票價格及投資部位又處於高檔，美股將面臨成長動能減弱與估值調整的雙重考驗。

美債殖利率升勢加劇　高盛示警恐演變成系統性風險

除了AI交易過度集中，利率上升也是Pasquariello最新報告中態度轉趨謹慎的重要原因。
他在10天前仍將利率上升視為股市的「逆風」，並認為尚未構成破壞性威脅；但最新報告已將其定位為主權債務與企業債務面臨的更大風險。
債市近期的變化加深市場疑慮。上週四，美國30年期公債標售得標殖利率達5.618%，創2000年8月以來新高；10年期美債殖利率則收在5.23%。
高盛經濟學家預期，在華許（Kevin Warsh）領導的聯準會政策情境下，聯準會9月升息至3.75%至4%後，12月可能再度升息。
高盛分析師Rikin Shah估算，10年期美債殖利率累計上升108個基點，其中98個基點來自實質利率上升；30年期實質殖利率達3.33%，已接近2010年以來的區間上緣。
Shah認為，美債市場正逐步逼近兩個可能的臨界點：一是AI相關融資需求開始受到高利率壓抑，二是經濟其他領域率先出現問題。
企業信用市場也出現警訊。高盛信用策略團隊指出，以美元計價的投資級公司債今年以來回報率為負292個基點，並特別關注面臨貸款到期與再融資壓力的軟體公司。
高盛經濟學家則估算，若利率維持目前水準，透過房市、消費及企業資本支出等管道，可能在2027年拖累經濟成長0.5個百分點。
高盛分析師Simonet進一步警告，期限溢酬上升將迫使市場重新評估所有長期現金流的價值，無論企業是否具備AI成長題材，都可能受到衝擊。
若聯準會為維持長天期債券市場的信譽而被迫超預期升息，將成為股市面臨的重要下行風險，而消費者物價指數（CPI）可能是近期觸發市場變化的關鍵數據。

AI與能源成為美股兩大支柱　但仍是同一場交易

Pasquariello在報告中提出一種相對樂觀的配置思路，也就是讓科技與能源兩大產業並行。
高盛統計過去11年市場表現發現，科技與能源各占一半的投資組合，有10年取得正報酬，年均報酬率達18.7%，夏普比率為1.2。
不過，這種配置仍與AI投資趨勢密切相關。AI資料中心建置需要大量電力，能源需求因此成為AI基礎建設擴張的重要配套，但如果AI投資降溫，相關資產也可能面臨連動風險。
Pasquariello的核心觀點是，當前美股的上漲趨勢、企業獲利、資金配置及能源需求，看似是不同的市場因素，實際上卻高度圍繞同一個主題：AI。
這也意味著，市場雖然可以在AI需求持續成長時享有強勁漲勢，但一旦核心假設改變，原本支撐行情的多項因素可能同時轉弱。

美國期中選舉增添波動　市場開始買進避險部位

除了企業財報與利率走勢，美國期中選舉也可能成為第四季市場波動的來源。
Pasquariello認為，第四季季節性因素整體偏向有利股市，但預計11月3日的期中選舉將帶來一波波動。
高盛分析師Alec Phillips指出，預測市場給予民主黨重新取得眾議院控制權的機率超過90%，奪回參議院的機率則為65%，民主黨在通用選票上的領先幅度達8.9個百分點，使民主黨同時掌握兩院的情境成為市場基準預期。
與此同時，VIX恐慌指數上週四收在15.4。高盛波動率交易部門則指出，當天有投資人約在6小時內，買進名目金額約1,000萬美元Vega的年底標普500看跌選擇權部位，顯示部分資金已開始為潛在波動提前布局。

高盛建議留意風險　美股多頭仍繫於AI財報與利率

面對當前市場環境，Pasquariello認為，美股多頭趨勢仍然成立，只是上漲動能集中於少數領域，近期風險與報酬的平衡也不再那麼明確。
在資產配置方面，他建議持續關注美國與日本市場，並以做多股票、做空利率的策略進行避險。
接下來，美股走勢將取決於幾項關鍵條件能否同時成立：美光與輝達財報符合市場期待、大型雲端業者持續投入AI基礎建設、聯準會升息幅度沒有超出預期，以及長天期美債仍有足夠買盤承接。
反過來說，只要其中一項條件失靈，就可能動搖目前高度集中的市場信心。

items.title: 美債殖利率難壓！黃金長期看漲情緒升溫  專家：指1年後必破「這一價位」
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Hard to Suppress! Gold Long‑Term Bullish Sentiment Heats Up – Expert Says It Must Break This Level Within a Year
paras: 今年初春以來，黃金走勢持續承壓，美債殖利率攀升與高通膨，推升市場鷹派利率預期，令金價難獲持續上行動力，但長期市場看漲情緒並未動搖。
上周，倫敦金銀市場協會(LBMA)在義大利索倫托舉行的年度全球貴金屬大會上傳遞出清晰訊號，不應將金價短期疲軟等同於長期走弱。
與會代表們預測，一年後的黃金價格將突破5000美元關口，均價上看每盎司5013.30美元，較目前現貨金價存在約20%的上漲空間。投資人不應只盯著價格，更要關注黃金在全球金融體系中不斷演變的角色，其變化速度遠超許多市場人士預期。
過去黃金多被視為對沖通膨、貨幣貶值與地緣動盪的工具，如今市場看待黃金的視角正在切換。
隨著市場對政府財政與傳統貨幣體系信心減弱，黃金成為提供資產保護的標的。美債殖利率此傳統利空因素，成為本次會議熱議焦點。傳統邏輯認為，美債殖利率走高會增加持有無息黃金的機會成本，壓制金價。
但代表指出，膨脹中的主權債務與惡化的財政狀況推高期限溢價，市場開始質疑政府公債的長期避險屬性。有基金經理人表示，黃金正釋放訊號，全球債務或已到達拐點，紙本信用資產供給可能超出市場需求。
央行購金是本次大會另一大核心議題。各國儲備管理者不再只把黃金當作抗通膨、避險地緣風險的工具。
黃金不存在交易對手風險，不會違約，實體持倉也難以被凍結。德國聯邦銀行行長指出，黃金佔全球央行儲備近四分之一，雖成長主要來自金價上漲而非新增買盤，但趨勢值得重視，央行正基於不確定的地緣環境重新評估黃金價值。
此外，技術與代幣化也受到關注。數位平台可望讓黃金交易、轉移、抵押更加便捷，拓寬投資者參與管道，儘管監管、託管等挑戰仍存，但其發展潛力不容小覷。
paras_en: Since early spring this year, gold has remained under pressure as rising U.S. Treasury yields and high inflation have lifted hawkish rate expectations, making it difficult for prices to gain sustained upward momentum, though long‑term bullish sentiment remains intact.

Last week, the London Bullion Market Association (LBMA) delivered a clear signal at its annual global precious metals conference in Sorrento, Italy: short‑term softness in gold should not be equated with a long‑term decline.

Conference participants forecast that gold prices will break the $5,000 barrier in a year’s time, with an average target of $5,013.30 per ounce – roughly a 20% upside from current spot levels. Investors should look beyond price and focus on gold’s evolving role in the global financial system, which is changing faster than many market participants expect.
Gold has traditionally been viewed as a hedge against inflation, currency depreciation and geopolitical turmoil, but the market’s perspective on gold is now shifting.

As confidence in government finances and the traditional monetary system wanes, gold is increasingly seen as an asset‑protection vehicle. The traditionally bearish factor of rising U.S. Treasury yields was a hot topic at the meeting. Conventional logic holds that higher yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non‑yielding gold, suppressing its price.

However, speakers noted that expanding sovereign debt and deteriorating fiscal conditions are pushing up term premiums, leading the market to question the long‑term hedging properties of government bonds. One fund manager said gold is signaling that global debt may have reached a turning point, and the supply of paper credit assets could outstrip demand.
Central‑bank gold purchases were another core theme of the conference. Reserve managers are no longer treating gold solely as an inflation‑hedge or a geopolitical‑risk safe haven.

Gold carries no counter‑party risk, cannot default, and physical holdings are hard to freeze. The president of Germany’s Bundesbank pointed out that gold accounts for nearly a quarter of global central‑bank reserves; although growth has come mainly from price appreciation rather than new purchases, the trend is noteworthy as central banks reassess gold’s value amid uncertain geopolitical conditions.

Technology and tokenisation also drew attention. Digital platforms could make gold trading, transfer and collateralisation more convenient, broadening investor participation, even though regulatory and custodial challenges remain, the development potential should not be underestimated.

items.title: 輝達表外承諾飆至5300億美元！SemiAnalysis：獲利夠強有望破1兆美元
items.title_en: Nvidia's Off‑Balance‑Sheet Commitments Surge to $530 Billion! SemiAnalysis: Strong Profits Could Push Valuation Past $1 Trillion
paras: 根據輝達最新的10-Q文件，該公司表外財務承諾與擔保總額約5300億美元，較上季約1840億美元大幅躍增、單季增幅逾180%，橫跨供應承諾、雲服務協議、未開始資料中心租約、股權投資、資本支出及額外擔保等六大類，市場關注其從「賣晶片」進一步變身AI基礎建設信用背書方。

文件顯示，截至7月26日的未來承諾約3660億美元，其中供應與產能2790億、雲服務協議290億、未開始資料中心租約250億、股權投資250億、資本支出80億；額外承諾含360億美元AI雲協議、200億美元擬轉讓第三方的數據中心租約，以及為客戶土地、電力、機房提供的擔保。本季增量主因包括記憶體等供應承諾擴大、為SB Energy俄亥俄州PORTS-Pike園區提供支援，該案一期約4.25GW、服務OpenAI；另新增Neocloud兜底與先簽後轉租架構。
研究機構SemiAnalysis分析文件後指出，輝達透過供應鎖貨、租約轉付、收入分成與殘值擔保，降低新興AI雲與非投資級客戶融資門檻，本質是「信用替代」。
SemiAnalysis預估，輝達截至2028年1月財年EBITDA約4500億美元，在保持安全邊際下，表外義務未來數年可進一步擴至1兆美元以上，但強調這是承接上限框架、非盈餘預測。
風險則在於景氣反轉。若AI資本支出放緩，供應承諾可能產生取消或調整成本，資料中心租約、雲協議與擔保則視客戶履約、替代承租及資產處分回收而定的恐產生損失；部分供應協議可取消、重排或調整，降低硬著陸壓力。
對投資人而言，僅看資產負債表已不足以評估真實步位，必須同時追蹤履約進度、擔保觸發條件與自由現金流。
paras_en: According to Nvidia’s latest 10‑Q filing, the company’s off‑balance‑sheet financial commitments and guarantees total roughly $530 billion, a massive jump from about $184 billion in the prior quarter—a seasonal increase of over 180%. The commitments span six categories: supply commitments, cloud‑service agreements, data‑center lease obligations that have not yet commenced, equity investments, capital expenditures, and additional guarantees. The market is watching Nvidia’s evolution from a pure chip seller to a credit‑backer of AI infrastructure.

The filing shows that, as of July 26, future commitments amount to about $366 billion, broken down into $279 billion for supply and capacity, $29 billion for cloud‑service agreements, $25 billion for data‑center leases not yet started, $25 billion for equity investments, and $8 billion for capital expenditures. Additional commitments include a $36 billion AI‑cloud agreement, a $20 billion tentative transfer of third‑party data‑center leases, and guarantees for customers’ land, power and rack space. The quarter’s increase is mainly driven by expanded supply commitments such as memory, support for SB Energy’s PORTS‑Pike site in Ohio (Phase 1 about 4.25 GW, serving OpenAI), and the addition of a Neocloud back‑stop and a “sign‑first‑then‑sub‑lease” structure.

Research firm SemiAnalysis, after reviewing the filing, notes that Nvidia is lowering financing barriers for emerging AI cloud providers and non‑investment‑grade customers by using supply lock‑ups, lease transfers, revenue‑sharing and residual‑value guarantees – essentially acting as a “credit substitute.”

SemiAnalysis estimates Nvidia’s FY2028 EBITDA to be around $450 billion. Assuming a comfortable safety margin, the off‑balance‑sheet obligations could expand to over $1 trillion in the coming years, though the firm stresses this is a ceiling framework, not an earnings forecast.

The risk lies in an economic downturn. If AI‑related capital spending slows, supply commitments could be cancelled or incur adjustment costs, and data‑center leases, cloud agreements and guarantees could suffer losses depending on customer performance, substitute tenancy or asset‑sale recoveries. Some supply agreements can be cancelled, reshuffled or adjusted, easing hard‑landing pressure.
For investors, looking at the balance sheet alone is insufficient to gauge the true exposure; they must also monitor commitment fulfilment, guarantee trigger conditions and free cash flow.

items.title: 美光單季賺贏蘋果！記憶體缺貨 讓晶片供應商掌握定價權
items.title_en: Micron Beats Apple in Quarterly Earnings! Memory Shortage Gives Chip Supplier Pricing Power
paras: 記憶體短缺正改變科技業的獲利版圖。美光(MU-US) 截至9月30日的第四財季淨利達377億美元，超過蘋果(AAPL-US) 同期的298億美元，單季多賺約80億美元。當蘋果仍需採購晶片，美光卻無法滿足客戶需求，供需失衡讓美光掌握定價權，也使蘋果面臨毛利率下滑壓力。
市場策略師Charlie Bilello在X平台以三句話概括這項轉變：「蘋果需要晶片。美光有晶片。美光決定價格。」
他指出，美光淨利在短短兩年間暴增42倍至約380億美元，比蘋果上一季還多約80億美元，並直言：「我們從未見過這樣的定價權。」
美光獲利快速攀升，也反映在每股獲利上。2024財年，美光標準化每股獲利僅1.30美元，2026財年已升至75.52美元。涵蓋2027財年的35位分析師預估，每股獲利將進一步達到176.15美元，較前一年再增逾一倍。
美光預估，2027財年第一季營收將達615億美元，高於剛公布的542億美元。Ritholtz Wealth Management執行長Josh Brown評論，美光的業績指引不僅未遭下修，反而持續上調。
美光執行長Sanjay Mehrotra接受CNBC訪問時則表示：「事實上，我們根本無法滿足客戶需求。」
供應商的定價優勢，正轉化為客戶的成本負擔。蘋果毛利率曾從2021財年的41.8%，逐年攀升至2025財年的46.9%，但過去累積的緩衝空間，如今正受到記憶體漲價侵蝕。
排除關稅退款影響後，蘋果毛利率由3月當季的49.3%，降至6月當季的48.1%，並預估9月當季將進一步降至約46.5%。
蘋果管理層明確指出，記憶體成本是6月當季毛利率下滑的主要原因，也將持續拖累9月當季表現，先前囤積庫存帶來的緩衝效果則將在9月後逐步消退。
蘋果前執行長庫克在7月財報電話會議上，曾將記憶體價格上漲形容為「百年一遇的洪水」，凸顯成本壓力之大。
面臨衝擊的不只蘋果。Egerton Capital共同創辦人John Armitage在Podcast節目《In Good Company》中指出，記憶體成本通膨及其對物料成本的影響，也是輝達面臨的一大問題。不過，輝達擁有75%的毛利率，吸收成本衝擊的空間遠大於蘋果。
即使獲利大幅躍升，市場仍對美光的成長延續性抱持疑慮。目前美光預估本益比為5.9倍，遠低於三年平均的10.5倍，反映投資人對這波超級循環能維持多久仍有疑問。
根據TIKR分析，只要需求持續超過供給，美光的定價權就不會消失。
供給端另有勞資爭議變數。據路透報導，美光台灣桃園工廠工會有1,994名成員、占投票人數99%，因獎金糾紛投票授權罷工。
台灣是美光DRAM與HBM的重要生產基地，但工會強調，授權並不代表立即罷工，具體時間與細節仍在討論。若實際停工，可能進一步收緊供給，加重蘋果的記憶體採購壓力。
蘋果預計10月23日發售首款摺疊螢幕手機iPhone Duo，售價1,999美元，或有助將部分成本轉嫁給消費者，但現有財測顯示，蘋果仍在自行吸收這筆開銷。
隨著下一份財報預計於10月下旬公布，記憶體成本是否持續攀升，將成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: Memory shortages are reshaping the profit landscape of the tech industry. Micron (MU-US) posted a net profit of $37.7 billion for its fourth fiscal quarter ending September 30, surpassing Apple’s (AAPL-US) $29.8 billion for the same period by about $8 billion. While Apple still needs to purchase chips, Micron cannot meet all customer demand, creating a supply‑demand imbalance that gives Micron pricing power and puts pressure on Apple’s gross margin.
Market strategist Charlie Bilello summed up the shift in three sentences on X: “Apple needs chips. Micron has chips. Micron sets the price.”

He noted that Micron’s net profit has exploded 42‑fold in just two years to roughly $38 billion—about $8 billion more than Apple earned in the previous quarter—and said, “We’ve never seen pricing power like this.”

Micron’s profit surge is also reflected in earnings per share. For fiscal 2024, Micron reported a standardized EPS of $1.30, which rose to $75.52 for fiscal 2026. Thirty‑five analysts covering fiscal 2027 project EPS to climb further to $176.15, more than double the prior year’s level.

Micron forecasts first‑quarter revenue of $61.5 billion for fiscal 2027, above the recently announced $54.2 billion. Josh Brown, CEO of Ritholtz Wealth Management, commented that Micron’s guidance has not only avoided cuts but continues to be raised.
In a CNBC interview, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said, “The fact is, we simply cannot satisfy customer demand.”

The supplier’s pricing advantage is turning into a cost burden for customers. Apple’s gross margin rose from 41.8% in fiscal 2021 to 46.9% in fiscal 2025, but the buffer built up over the years is now being eroded by rising memory prices.
Excluding tariff refunds, Apple’s gross margin fell from 49.3% in the March quarter to 48.1% in the June quarter, and it is projected to drop further to about 46.5% in the September quarter.

Apple’s management explicitly said that memory costs were the main driver of the June‑quarter margin decline and will continue to drag down September‑quarter performance, while the cushioning effect of previously stockpiled inventory will gradually disappear after September.
Former Apple CEO Tim Cook described the surge in memory prices during the July earnings call as a “once‑in‑a‑century flood,” underscoring the magnitude of the cost pressure.

The impact is not limited to Apple. John Armitage, co‑founder of Egerton Capital, noted on the podcast “In Good Company” that memory‑cost inflation and its effect on material costs are also a major issue for Nvidia. However, Nvidia’s 75% gross margin gives it far more room to absorb cost shocks than Apple does.

Even with the profit jump, the market remains skeptical about Micron’s growth sustainability. Micron’s current forward P/E is 5.9×, well below its three‑year average of 10.5×, reflecting investor doubts about how long this super‑cycle can last.
According to TIKR analysis, as long as demand continues to outpace supply, Micron’s pricing power will not disappear.

On the supply side, labor‑relations issues add uncertainty. Reuters reported that the union at Micron’s Taoyuan, Taiwan plant, representing 1,994 members (99% of voters), voted to authorize a strike over a bonus dispute.

Taiwan is a key production hub for Micron’s DRAM and HBM, but the union stressed that authorization does not mean an immediate strike; timing and details are still being discussed. If a shutdown occurs, supply could tighten further, increasing pressure on Apple’s memory procurement.

Apple plans to launch its first foldable‑screen phone, the iPhone Duo, on October 23 at a price of $1,999, which could help shift some costs to consumers. However, current financial forecasts show Apple is still absorbing the expense itself.
With the next earnings report expected in late October, whether memory costs continue to rise will be a focal point for the market.

items.title: 亞馬遜傳砸70億美元收購AI新創Decart！搶攻AI晶片切換技術、強化算力布局
items.title_en: Amazon Plans $7 B Acquisition of AI Startup Decart to Boost Chip Switching Tech and Compute Power
paras: 據知情人士透露，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 正洽談收購人工智慧（AI）新創公司Decart，交易估值可能達到約70億美元。若交易順利完成，將進一步擴大亞馬遜在AI運算領域的布局，尤其Decart開發的軟體可協助開發者在不同AI晶片之間切換，隨著科技業競相爭奪運算資源，相關技術的重要性也日益提升。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，總部位於舊金山的Decart，其技術可降低開發者轉換不同AI晶片的難度。知情人士表示，若雙方談判未破局，也沒有其他潛在買家加入競爭，交易可能很快敲定。
根據PitchBook資料，Decart已從創投投資人募得超過4億美元，投資者包括紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）、Benchmark及Radical Ventures。今年5月，該公司的估值接近40億美元。
Decart於2023年由3名以色列工程師創立，分別為兄弟檔Dean Leitersdorf與Orian Leitersdorf，以及Moshe Shalev。
此外，該公司也正在開發名為Lucy與Oasis的世界模型（world models）。這類模型能夠生成並模擬真實世界的3D環境。
與此同時，亞馬遜正積極發展自研AI晶片Trainium3，與目前仍主導圖形處理器（GPU）市場的輝達(NVDA-US) 競爭。
GPU是支撐當前AI熱潮的重要硬體，隨著AI模型訓練與推論需求攀升，晶片供應及運算效率成為科技業競爭的關鍵。
根據《華爾街日報》先前報導，亞馬遜旗下雲端服務部門AWS於2025年與Decart接觸後，對其創辦團隊留下深刻印象，並讓Decart提前取得Trainium3晶片的使用權。
亞馬遜近年持續透過大型收購擴展業務版圖。2022年，亞馬遜以65億美元收購美高梅電影公司（MGM）。
今年稍早，亞馬遜也宣布以約110億美元收購Globalstar。 Globalstar被視為SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下星鏈（Starlink）的競爭對手之一。
以色列媒體Calcalist本月稍早亦報導，Decart正與一家大型科技公司進行深入的出售談判。
paras_en: According to sources, Amazon (AMZN-US) is in talks to acquire AI startup Decart in a deal that could be valued at about $7 billion. If completed, the purchase would further expand Amazon’s AI computing footprint, especially as Decart’s software helps developers switch between different AI chips, a capability growing in importance as tech firms vie for compute resources.

The Wall Street Journal reports that San‑Francisco‑based Decart has technology that reduces the difficulty for developers to transition between AI chips. Sources say that if negotiations stay on track and no other bidders emerge, the deal could be sealed quickly.

PitchBook data shows Decart has raised over $400 million from venture investors, including Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Radical Ventures. In May this year the company was valued at nearly $4 billion.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers: brothers Dean Leitersdorf and Orian Leitersdorf, along with Moshe Shalev.
The company is also developing world models called Lucy and Oasis, which can generate and simulate realistic 3D environments.
At the same time, Amazon is actively developing its own AI chip, Trainium 3, to compete with Nvidia (NVDA-US), which still dominates the GPU market.

GPUs are the key hardware powering the current AI boom, and as demand for model training and inference climbs, chip supply and compute efficiency have become critical competitive factors for the tech industry.
A previous Wall Street Journal report noted that after AWS first contacted Decart in 2025, the cloud unit was impressed by the founding team and gave Decart early access to Trainium 3 chips.
Amazon has been expanding its business through large acquisitions in recent years. In 2022 it bought MGM for $6.5 billion.
Earlier this year Amazon announced a roughly $11 billion acquisition of Globalstar, which is seen as a competitor to SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) Starlink satellite network.
Israeli media outlet Calcalist reported earlier this month that Decart is in deep sale negotiations with a major technology company.

items.title: 美50年數據敲警鐘：AI恐持續擠壓勞動所得  生產力與勞動份額持續分化
items.title_en: U.S. 50-Year Data Sounds Alarm: AI May Keep Squeezing Labor Income as Productivity and Labor Share Diverge
paras: AI浪潮之下，市場普遍擔憂技術迭代會進一步壓低勞工在國民所得中的分配佔比，美國過去五十年的生產力與薪資數據則為此討論提供關鍵參考。
數據顯示，美國企業每小時實際產出已較1973年翻倍，但勞工實際時薪漲幅並未同步。企業產出中的勞動份額，從1973年約63%下滑至2025年約55%，近期美國國民經濟核算修訂並未扭轉此一格局。
根據瑞銀分析，本次收入上調主要來自利息收入，勞動收入上調幅度有限，總量改善不等於勞工購買力同步提升。
需要釐清的是，生產力與實際薪酬採用兩套不同價格統計口徑。生產率使用企業產出價格折算，實際時薪依據CPI調整，兩組數據差值不能全部歸因為勞動收入轉移到資本。在2000年之前，統計口徑差異能解釋大部分差距，2000年後，勞動份額本身下檔成為主導因素。即便勞工實際報酬持續成長，其在總產出中佔比仍可能走低。勞動份額之外產出還需涵蓋資本折舊、利息與稅費，勞動佔比下滑幅度不等於企業利潤擴張幅度。

根據高盛上月對商業部門拆解的報告，勞動份額較1990年代平均值下降約7.5個百分點。該行估算，約四成降幅來自統計與分類偏差，並非真實所得分配轉移。一方面，1986年美國稅改推動企業改用穿透型組織架構，部分薪資收入計入企業利潤，直接壓低統計層面勞動份額。另一方面，電腦、軟體等短週期資產佔比提升推高折舊開支；勞動份額分母包含折舊，也會拉低佔比，不代表資本所有者獲得等額淨收益。同時股權激勵存在計算缺口，部分選擇權收益未能納入薪資統計，造成勞動報酬被低估。
剔除統計擾動後，剩餘約六成、接近4.5個百分點的降幅屬於真實分配變化。高盛認為，企業加價能力提升、自動化普及、勞動者議價能力走弱是核心驅動，三者交織難以單獨量化。市佔率向用工規模較小的「超級企業」集中，進一步拉低整體勞動份額；製造業機器人滲透率較高的行業，勞動份額降幅更明顯，工會力量弱化也削弱勞工議價能力。
對於AI帶來的影響，高盛提出關鍵判斷：勞動份額能否企穩，取決於AI替代勞工任務的速度與創造新職位的速度孰快孰慢。若任務替代持續快於崗位創造，勞動收入佔比或將進一步承壓。
短期經濟數據來看，根據瑞銀測算，2026年第二季美國非農業商業生產力年增2.3%，單位勞動成本成長2.2%，未見生產力大幅躍升，同期實質薪資收入年增0.8%，低於實質消費支出2.5%的成長速度；個人儲蓄率雖小幅上修至4.4%，仍低於一年前水準。科技變革的長期紅利如何更公平惠及勞工，仍是宏觀經濟需要直面的核心命題。
paras_en: Amid the AI wave, markets broadly worry that rapid technological iteration will further depress the share of national income that goes to workers. The United States’ productivity and wage data over the past fifty years provide a crucial reference for this debate.

The data show that U.S. firms’ real output per hour has doubled since 1973, but workers’ real hourly wages have not kept pace. The labor share of corporate output fell from about 63% in 1973 to roughly 55% in 2025, and recent revisions to the national accounts have not reversed this trend.

According to UBS analysis, the recent rise in total income comes mainly from higher interest earnings, while the increase in labor income is modest; a rise in aggregate income does not translate into an equivalent boost in workers’ purchasing power.

It is important to note that productivity and real compensation are measured using two different price bases. Productivity is valued at firm‑output prices, whereas real hourly wages are CPI‑adjusted. The gap between the two series cannot be fully attributed to a shift of labor income to capital. Before 2000, most of the divergence can be explained by the statistical‑definition difference; after 2000, a genuine decline in the labor share becomes the dominant factor. Even if workers’ real compensation keeps growing, its proportion of total output can still fall. The labor share’s denominator also includes capital depreciation, interest and taxes, so a drop in the labor share does not equal the magnitude of profit expansion.

Based on Goldman Sachs’ latest sector‑level report, the labor share is about 7.5 percentage points lower than its 1990s average. The bank estimates that roughly 40% of that decline stems from statistical and classification biases rather than a real shift in income distribution. One source is the 1986 U.S. tax reform that encouraged firms to adopt pass‑through structures, causing part of payroll to be recorded as corporate profit and thus lowering the reported labor share. Another is the rising share of short‑life assets such as computers and software, which raises depreciation expense; because depreciation is part of the labor‑share denominator, the share falls even though capital owners do not necessarily earn an equivalent net gain. In addition, gaps in equity‑compensation accounting mean that some stock‑option gains are omitted from wage statistics, further understating labor compensation.

After stripping out statistical distortions, about 60% of the decline—or roughly 4.5 percentage points—reflects a genuine redistribution. Goldman Sachs attributes this to three intertwined forces: firms’ growing pricing power, the spread of automation, and weakening bargaining power of workers. The effect is hard to isolate quantitatively. Market share is concentrating in “super‑large” firms that employ fewer workers per unit of output, pulling the overall labor share down; industries with high robot penetration, especially manufacturing, see an even sharper drop, and the erosion of union strength further weakens workers’ negotiating leverage.

Regarding AI’s impact, Goldman Sachs offers a key judgment: whether the labor share can stabilize depends on whether AI’s speed of substituting labor tasks outpaces the speed of creating new jobs. If task substitution continues to outstrip job creation, the labor‑income share will face additional pressure.

Short‑term data show that, according to UBS estimates, U.S. non‑farm business productivity grew 2.3% year‑over‑year in Q2 2026 and unit labor costs rose 2.2%, indicating no sharp productivity jump. Real hourly wages rose 0.8% year‑over‑year, lagging behind the 2.5% growth in real consumer spending. The personal savings rate was nudged up to 4.4% but remains below last year’s level. How the long‑run gains from technological change can be shared more equitably with workers remains a core macro‑economic challenge.

items.title: AI舉債熱潮降溫 9月全球發行量腰斬、投資人重估風險
items.title_en: AI Debt Boom Wanes as September Global Issuance Halved, Investors Reassess Risk
paras: 經歷數月大規模舉債後，投資人開始重新評估人工智慧（AI）產業風險，科技企業為AI專案籌資所發行的新債，9月明顯降溫。
摩根士丹利(MS-US) 統計公開債券與私募配售交易，9月全球AI相關債務發行規模降至230億美元，不到8月的一半；自6月創下1130億美元歷史高峰後，新增融資持續回落。企業當時發債，主要為資料中心、晶片等AI關鍵基礎設施籌資。
摩根士丹利指出，發債量下滑，首先是企業今年稍早已完成大規模舉債；投資人也愈來愈關注龐大投資能否長期帶來回報，以及美國資料中心建設面臨的民間與政治阻力。1至8月，美國大型科技企業在美國投資等級債券市場累計發債約3060億美元，9月AI相關債券發行幾乎停滯。
摩根士丹利數據顯示，2026年至今企業已發行約4660億美元AI相關債務，去年同期為1010億美元。大量新增供給讓信貸投資人得以要求部分專案提供較高收益率，也推升大型雲端服務業者借貸成本。投資人同時審慎看待企業攀升的債務負擔，以及前景仍不明朗的資本支出需求。
市場情緒轉變之際，數筆用於購買先進AI晶片的大型融資交易即將登場。華爾街銀行正為博通(AVGO-US) 與Anthropic籌組600億美元融資；SpaceX(SPCX-US) 也在洽談籌集400億美元，以採購輝達(NVDA-US) 晶片。兩筆交易預計未來數月透過銀團方式分銷給廣泛投資人。
美國各地資料中心計畫接連遭居民反對，民眾憂心高耗能設施影響供水與空氣品質。甲骨文(ORCL-US) 位於新墨西哥州的「木星計畫」園區因難以接入電力而成為焦點。
甲骨文已發出不可抗力通知，約180億美元配套貸款壓力因此加大。知情交易人士透露，近期這類貸款在私下交易市場的價格約為面額的85美分。
Monarch Alternative Capital董事總經理暨歐洲信貸主管Jordan Rieger表示，近期融資放緩讓信貸投資人有機會重新評估信用風險與融資工具架構。他形容，市場彷彿「一邊開火車，一邊鋪設鐵軌」，希望列車不會在釀成嚴重後果前脫軌。
困境債務機構波盧斯資本（Polus Capital）首席投資長Rob Dafforn指出，市場充斥投機性高、槓桿沉重的交易，部分投資人已付出過高成本。融資成本偏高，加上專案回報時程與收益曲線不確定，使他難以判斷價值將落在產業鏈哪個環節。
該機構已開始梳理AI融資交易網絡，但尚未實際投資。
paras_en: After months of large-scale borrowing, investors have begun to reassess the risks of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, and the new debt issued by tech companies to fund AI projects cooled noticeably in September.

Morgan Stanley (MS-US) statistics on public bonds and private placements show that global AI-related debt issuance fell to $23 billion in September, less than half of August’s level; since hitting a record high of $113 billion in June, new financing has continued to decline. At that time, companies issued debt mainly to fund AI-critical infrastructure such as data centers and chips.

Morgan Stanley noted that the drop in issuance is partly because companies had already completed large borrowings earlier this year, and investors are increasingly concerned about whether massive investments can yield long-term returns, as well as the private and political resistance facing U.S. data center construction. From January to August, U.S. large technology firms issued about $306 billion in investment-grade bonds, while AI-related bond issuance in September almost stalled.

Morgan Stanley data shows that from 2026 to now, companies have issued about $466 billion in AI-related debt, compared with $101 billion in the same period last year. The large influx of new supply has allowed credit investors to demand higher yields on certain projects, also driving up borrowing costs for large cloud service providers. Investors are also cautious about companies’ rising debt burdens and the still uncertain capital expenditure needs.

During this shift in market sentiment, several large financing deals aimed at purchasing advanced AI chips are set to surface. Wall Street banks are arranging $60 billion of financing for Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Anthropic; SpaceX (SPCX-US) is also negotiating to raise $40 billion to purchase NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips. Both deals are expected to be distributed to a wide range of investors through syndication in the coming months.

Data center projects across the United States have repeatedly faced local opposition, as residents worry that high‑energy facilities will affect water supply and air quality. Oracle (ORCL-US)’s “Jupiter Project” campus in New Mexico has become a focal point due to difficulties in accessing power.

Oracle has issued a force majeure notice, increasing the pressure on the roughly $18 billion in related loans. An informed trader disclosed that recently such loans are trading in the private market at about 85 cents on the dollar face value.

Jordan Rieger, Managing Director and Head of European Credit at Monarch Alternative Capital, said the recent slowdown in financing gives credit investors an opportunity to reassess credit risk and financing structure. He described the market as “like a train that’s both running and laying tracks,” hoping the train won’t derail before serious consequences arise.

Rob Dafforn, Chief Investment Officer of Polus Capital, a distressed debt firm, pointed out that the market is saturated with speculative, highly leveraged deals, and some investors have already paid too high a cost. With high financing costs and uncertain project return timelines and yield curves, he finds it difficult to determine where value will land in the industry chain.
Polus Capital has begun mapping the AI financing transaction network, but has not yet made any actual investments.

items.title: 川普放寬俄羅斯燃料制裁違法？7名跨黨派參議員要求撤回柴油協議
items.title_en: Trump's Relaxation of Russian Fuel Sanctions May Be Illegal? Seven Bipartisan Senators Call for Diesel Deal Withdrawal
paras: 美國總統川普與俄羅斯達成柴油供應協議，引發美國國會跨黨派反彈。7名共和、民主黨參議員週日（11日）聯合要求川普政府立即撤回決定，指出美國法律禁止俄羅斯在停止對烏克蘭侵略行動前出口能源至美國，政府此舉不僅可能違法，也形同為俄羅斯總統普丁提供戰爭資金。
根據《路透》報導，這份聯合聲明由4名共和黨及3名民主黨參議員共同發布。參議員指出，國會2022年明確禁止進口俄羅斯能源，目的就是避免美國資金流入俄羅斯，成為普丁對烏克蘭發動戰爭的財政支柱。
議員也質疑，川普政府在做出相關決策前，既未與國會協商，也未依法律要求提交決策說明。
他們強調，在俄羅斯持續殺害烏克蘭平民之際，美國不應向普丁提供財政援助，要求政府立即改變政策。
發布聲明的共和黨參議員包括緬因州的柯林斯（Susan Collins）、阿拉斯加州的穆考斯基（Lisa Murkowski）、北卡羅來納州的提里斯（Thom Tillis），以及猶他州的柯蒂斯（John Curtis）；民主黨參議員則包括新罕布夏州的夏欣（Jeanne Shaheen）、康乃狄克州的布魯門索（Richard Blumenthal），以及奧勒岡州的懷登（Ron Wyden）。
這是近期美國國會跨黨派人士對川普這項協議提出的最新批評。距離11月3日美國期中選舉僅剩數周，這也顯示，共和黨內對川普外交政策的支持不再如先前般一致。這場選舉將決定共和黨能否繼續掌控國會。
柴油價格持續攀升，是川普政府推動這項協議的重要背景。柴油廣泛用於農業、住宅供暖及貨運運輸，目前價格已接近歷史高點，可能對共和黨在下個月的國會選舉造成不利影響。
即將於明年1月卸任的共和黨參議員提里斯週日接受《NBC》訪問時表示，這項柴油協議可能違法，甚至可能危及美國人的生命安全。他認為，外界確實有充分理由質疑總統是否遵守法律。
川普上週五表示，俄羅斯已同意向全球市場供應柴油。與此同時，美國政府暫時放寬對俄羅斯燃料的制裁，相關制裁原本旨在削弱莫斯科為對烏戰爭籌措資金的能力。
不過，分析人士認為，川普與莫斯科達成的協議，不太可能讓燃料價格持續下降。

財政部長捍衛協議　稱政府將依法推動

面對國會批評，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日為川普政府辯護，強調政府將運用現有法律授權落實協議，並認為這項安排符合美國民眾利益，有助於降低價格。
貝森特接受《福斯新聞》訪問時表示，政府將在現有法律授權範圍內推動協議。他也反駁國會人士對相關禁令的解讀，認為無論是過去通過的法案，或目前由共和黨參議員葛蘭姆（Lindsey Graham）推動的法案，都不會阻止政府執行這項安排。
川普上月簽署一項全面性的俄羅斯制裁法案，正式名稱為《2026年林賽・葛蘭姆制裁俄羅斯與伊朗法案》（Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026），以紀念這名共和黨籍南卡羅來納州參議員。葛蘭姆長期對俄羅斯採取強硬立場，並於7月去世。
然而，共和黨內部仍有反對聲音。即將卸任的內布拉斯加州共和黨眾議員培根（Don Bacon）週五在社群平台X發文表示，為普丁的戰爭經濟提供支撐，在道德上是錯誤的，因為俄羅斯會利用這筆資金轟炸城市。
川普的前副總統潘斯（Mike Pence）也將解除俄羅斯石油制裁的決定形容為對葛蘭姆政治遺產的「背叛」，並呼籲川普撤銷決策。
隨著川普民調支持度大幅下滑，共和黨國會議員也逐漸與總統保持距離，分歧議題不僅涉及俄羅斯政策，還包括伊朗衝突及與加拿大的貿易戰。
不過，參議院共和黨第二號人物、懷俄明州參議員巴拉索（John Barrasso）仍為協議辯護。他表示，川普正致力於降低民眾生活成本，總統必須在多重考量之間做出艱難決定。

加拿大批評協議與歐洲和平目標背道而馳

加拿大也對美俄柴油協議表達反對立場。加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）週日與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskiy）通話時，明確指出，這項協議與烏克蘭、加拿大及盟友推動歐洲和平與穩定的努力直接相悖。
另一方面，川普週日在社群媒體發文宣稱，烏克蘭與俄羅斯已同意立即實施他所稱的「能源停火」，但未進一步說明協議內容。
澤倫斯基表示，烏克蘭仍在等待這項協議的具體細節。他指出，烏克蘭支持停火，俄羅斯也必須採取相同立場。
不過，莫斯科截至目前尚未對川普的相關宣布作出回應。這項宣布之前，美國已連續數日向烏克蘭施壓，要求基輔停止攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump reached a diesel supply agreement with Russia, sparking bipartisan backlash in Congress. Seven Republican and Democratic senators on Sunday (the 11th) jointly demanded that the Trump administration immediately rescind the decision, noting that U.S. law prohibits Russia from exporting energy to the United States before it halts its invasion of Ukraine, and that the move could not only be illegal but also effectively fund President Vladimir Putin’s war.

According to Reuters, the joint statement was issued by four Republicans and three Democrats. The senators pointed out that Congress explicitly banned imports of Russian energy in 2022 to prevent U.S. money from flowing to Russia and becoming a financial pillar for Putin’s war against Ukraine.
Lawmakers also questioned why the Trump administration made the decision without consulting Congress or providing the legally required explanatory memorandum.
They stressed that while Russia continues to kill Ukrainian civilians, the United States should not provide financial assistance to Putin and called for an immediate policy reversal.

The Republican senators signing the statement include Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, Thom Tillis of North Carolina, and John Curtis of Utah; the Democratic senators are Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire, Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut, and Ron Wyden of Oregon.

This is the latest criticism from bipartisan members of Congress of Trump’s deal, coming just weeks before the November 3 midterm elections, and it signals that support for Trump’s foreign policy within the GOP is no longer as unified as before. The election will determine whether Republicans retain control of Congress.

Rising diesel prices, a key backdrop to the administration’s push for the deal, have been climbing sharply. Diesel is widely used in agriculture, home heating and freight transport, and prices are now near historic highs, potentially hurting Republican prospects in next month’s congressional races.

Outgoing Republican Senator Thom Tillis, who will leave office in January, told NBC on Sunday that the diesel agreement may be illegal and could even endanger American lives. He said there are ample reasons to question whether the president is obeying the law.

Trump said last Friday that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to the global market. At the same time, the U.S. government temporarily eased sanctions on Russian fuel, sanctions that were originally intended to curb Moscow’s ability to fund its war against Ukraine.
Analysts, however, doubt that the Trump‑Moscow deal will keep fuel prices falling over the long term.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended the agreement on Sunday, asserting that the administration will implement the deal under existing legal authority and that the arrangement serves the American public’s interest by helping lower prices.

In an interview with Fox News, Bessent said the government will move forward with the agreement within the scope of current legal authorizations. He also pushed back against congressional interpretations of the bans, arguing that neither past legislation nor the bill currently championed by Republican Senator Lindsey Graham would block the administration from carrying out the arrangement.

Last month Trump signed a sweeping Russia sanctions bill formally titled the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, named after the late South Carolina Republican senator who had long taken a hard line on Russia and died in July.

Nevertheless, dissent remains within the GOP. Outgoing Republican Representative Don Bacon of Nebraska posted on X on Friday that supporting Putin’s war economy is morally wrong because Russia would use the funds to bomb cities.
Former Vice President Mike Pence also called the decision to lift Russian oil sanctions a “betrayal” of Graham’s political legacy and urged Trump to reverse the move.

As Trump’s poll numbers have plummeted, Republican members of Congress are increasingly distancing themselves from the president, with disagreements extending beyond Russia policy to include the Iran conflict and a trade war with Canada.

Senate Republican No. 2, Wyoming’s John Barrasso, however, continues to defend the deal, saying Trump is working to lower living costs and that the president must make tough choices amid competing considerations.

Canada also voiced opposition to the U.S.–Russia diesel deal. Prime Minister Mark Carney told Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday that the agreement runs counter to the peace and stability efforts that Ukraine, Canada and allies are pursuing in Europe.

Meanwhile, Trump posted on social media on Sunday claiming that Ukraine and Russia have agreed to immediately implement what he called an “energy cease‑fire,” without providing further details of the agreement.
Zelensky said Ukraine is still awaiting concrete details of the deal. He noted that Ukraine supports a cease‑fire and that Russia must adopt the same stance.
However, Moscow has not yet responded to Trump’s announcement. Prior to the announcement, the United States had pressed Ukraine for several days to stop attacks on Russian oil refineries.

items.title: 談妥又生變！傳歐盟打算用關稅配額限中國混動車　年進口從80萬砍至40萬
items.title_en: Negotiated Then Changed! EU Plans to Use Tariff Quotas to Limit Chinese Hybrid Cars, Annual Imports Cut from 800,000 to 400,000
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，歐盟打算以貿易保障措施將自中國進口的混合動力汽車年量由2026年預估約80萬輛，削減至約40萬輛、降幅約一半。
《彭博資訊》上周六(10日)引述知情人士報道，歐盟執委會貿易與經濟安全委員謝夫喬維奇已向內部官員說明相關方向，擬以關稅配額為主，配額內按較低稅率進口，超量部分加徵高稅。具體機制未定，若獲歐盟領導層批准，最快12月生效。
此案緊接中歐貿易投資磋商機制第二次例會。上周五(9日)，中國商務部長王文濤與謝夫喬維奇在北京會談，雙方就貿易投資平衡、出口管制、知識產權及世貿改革等達成16項共識；中方清單稱以符合世貿規則方式就混動車貿易「達成諒解」，未列具體數量。
謝夫喬維奇會後表示，未來四年中國對歐混動與插混出口可較「無協議情境」減一半以上、涉數百萬輛。
中國商務部歐洲司上周六強調，雙方按尊重事實、非歧視、符合世貿原則磋商，避免局面升級，維護中國企業出口利益與歐洲市場穩定。
歐盟之所以盯上混動，是因為中國汽車在純電被加稅後轉道增長。
根據《路透社》數據，截至今年9月的一年期間，歐盟插電混動進口量增86%、進口價跌約20%；中國品牌在歐混動份額快速擴大，加重本土車廠壓力。不同於純電反補貼稅，保障措施不一定以「不公平貿易」為前提，但須證明進口激增、歐洲產業受嚴重損害或威脅，且通常非針對單一國；中方已多次反對「自願出口限制」式數量管控。
歐盟成員國下周峰會將討論後續。業界關注配額基數、車型範圍、是否含本土化生產，以及會否影響比亞迪、MG等對歐交付，而中國車廠加速匈牙利、西班牙等在地建廠，可部分抵消整車進口限制。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the EU intends to use trade safeguard measures to reduce the annual volume of hybrid vehicles imported from China from an estimated 800,000 units in 2026 to about 400,000 units, a cut of roughly half.

Bloomberg last Saturday (the 10th) quoted insiders saying EU Commission Trade and Economic Security Commissioner Janusz Wojciechowski has briefed internal officials on the plan, which would rely mainly on tariff quotas: vehicles within the quota would be imported at a lower rate, while any excess would face a high tariff. The exact mechanism is not yet set, but if approved by EU leadership it could take effect as early as December.

The move follows the second regular meeting of the China‑EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism. On Friday (the 9th), Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao met with Wojciechowski in Beijing, where the two sides reached 16 points of consensus on trade‑investment balance, export controls, intellectual property and WTO reforms; the Chinese list notes that an “understanding” on hybrid‑car trade was reached in line with WTO rules, without specifying quantities.

Wojciechowski said after the meeting that over the next four years Chinese exports of hybrid and plug‑in hybrid vehicles to the EU could be reduced by more than half compared with a “no‑agreement” scenario, amounting to several million units.

The EU desk of China’s Ministry of Commerce emphasized on Saturday that both sides are negotiating based on respect for facts, non‑discrimination and WTO principles, seeking to avoid escalation and to protect the interests of Chinese exporters and the stability of the European market.
The EU is targeting hybrids because Chinese carmakers have shifted growth toward them after pure‑electric vehicles were hit with higher tariffs.

According to Reuters data, in the twelve‑month period ending September this year EU imports of plug‑in hybrids rose 86% while import prices fell about 20%; Chinese brands are rapidly expanding their share of the European hybrid market, increasing pressure on domestic manufacturers. Unlike anti‑subsidy duties on pure‑electric cars, safeguard measures do not have to be based on “unfair trade” but must show a surge in imports that seriously harms or threatens European industry, and they are usually not aimed at a single country; China has repeatedly opposed quantity controls framed as “voluntary export restraints.”

EU member states will discuss the next steps at next week’s summit. Industry observers are watching the quota base, the range of models covered, whether locally‑produced units are included, and whether the measures will affect deliveries from BYD, MG and others to Europe, while Chinese automakers are accelerating plant construction in Hungary, Spain and elsewhere to partially offset full‑vehicle import limits.

items.title: 川普宣布俄烏「能源停火」只是自嗨？普丁未證實、澤連斯基起初稱「不知情」
paras: 美國總統川普單方面宣布俄羅斯與烏克蘭已同意實施「能源停火」，但俄方至今未證實相關協議，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基則從最初表示不知情，轉而表態支持停止攻擊彼此能源設施。這場由華府主導的停火外交，不僅牽動俄烏戰爭走向，也凸顯美國在期中選舉前面臨的能源價格壓力。
根據《新華社》報導，川普週日（11日）在社群媒體發文表示，俄烏衝突即刻進入「能源停火」狀態，並宣稱雙方均已同意。
然而，澤倫斯基當天稍早表示，這項宣布令他感到意外，此前並未獲知相關安排。俄羅斯方面則沒有立即回應，克里姆林宮也未確認協議存在。
不過，澤倫斯基隨後調整立場，表示烏克蘭支持切實可行、可靠的停火與結束戰爭方案，願意停止攻擊俄羅斯能源設施，並期待俄方採取對等行動。他也指出，烏克蘭武裝部隊已收到相關命令。
若能源停火真正落實，俄烏雙方對彼此能源基礎設施的攻擊可望暫時停止，進而影響市場對全球石油與天然氣供應的預期。

美國能源價格高漲　川普急推停火外交

川普推動能源停火，背後也有美國國內政治考量。
隨著期中選舉逼近，汽油與柴油價格居高不下，成為共和黨面臨的政治壓力之一。中東衝突干擾能源出口，加上俄烏雙方持續攻擊能源設施，均加劇市場對供應穩定性的疑慮。
《新華社》報導指出，美國近期出現柴油供應緊張情況，川普將能源價格高漲部分歸因於俄烏雙方互相攻擊能源設施。他9日也宣布，美俄領導人已就俄羅斯向美國及全球市場供應柴油達成一致。
然而，這項安排能否有效緩解能源市場壓力，仍存在疑問。
德國國際與安全事務研究所東歐研究主任Janis Kluge指出，俄羅斯原本就計畫恢復柴油出口，因此俄羅斯總統普丁並未在這項交易中作出實質讓步。
他並認為，相較於俄羅斯柴油出口，中東局勢對能源市場的影響更為重大。

俄方未確認停火　烏克蘭持續遭遇能源設施攻擊

儘管川普宣稱俄烏雙方已同意能源停火，莫斯科至今仍未證實相關安排。
報導指出，普丁迄今拒絕能源停火提議，俄羅斯11日也繼續攻擊烏克蘭能源電網及基輔其他目標，當地爆炸聲不斷，停電情況仍在持續。
這也不是川普首次宣布能源停火。川普先前曾於9月14日宣布類似安排，但俄烏雙方之後仍持續攻擊對方目標。
法國總統馬克宏在社群媒體上表態支持能源停火，但同時指出，俄羅斯目前仍拒絕相關安排，並在過去數小時內加強攻擊烏克蘭基礎設施。
澤倫斯基則透露，過去一週，俄羅斯對烏克蘭電力系統發動196次攻擊，對油氣基礎設施發動20次攻擊，導彈與無人機襲擊城市共造成153人死亡。
他認為，俄羅斯持續發動攻擊，反映俄方尚未感受到足夠壓力，仍有意繼續戰爭。不過，若俄羅斯確實希望停止攻擊能源設施，烏克蘭願意考慮相關安排。

烏克蘭握有反制籌碼　能源設施成停火談判關鍵

在俄烏能源停火的角力中，烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油廠的打擊能力，成為重要談判籌碼。
烏克蘭官員近日表示，除非俄羅斯改變立場，接受雙方相互停止攻擊能源設施，否則基輔將繼續打擊俄羅斯煉油廠。
與此同時，烏克蘭也逐步調整對外部軍事支援的依賴結構。
大西洋理事會副主任Shelby Magid指出，烏克蘭仍將美國視為關鍵盟友，但已逐漸發展出因應美國政策變動的能力，尤其是透過深化與歐洲國家的合作。
報導指出，烏克蘭已大幅擴大無人機等武器的國內生產，並在資金與軍事援助方面更加依賴歐洲盟友；另一方面，川普政府基本上已終止對烏克蘭的國防援助。

items.title: AZIO德州簽資料中心供電合約 商機上看4.5億美元
items.title_en: AZIO Signs Power Supply Contract for Texas Data Center, Opportunity Seen at $450 Million
paras: 2026年10月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國AI基礎建設業者AZIO AI Holdings(AZIO-US)近日宣布，旗下德州Atlas One資料中心與Power Champion簽署電力及託管服務合約，初期提供10MW電力容量，客戶未來可選擇再增加40MW，使合約規模最高擴大至50MW。若全部容量完成交付並持續收費五年，AZIO的潛在固定收入最高可達4.5億美元。
根據合約，目前正式簽約的10MW容量，每月可收取150萬美元固定費用，五年合計約9,000萬美元。這筆費用相當於客戶預訂10MW供電容量，即使沒有全部使用，仍須依約支付。此外，實際用電量另按每度0.13美元計費。
AZIO表示，Atlas One的變電站及配電設施尚未完工，客戶也須取得GPU進口與部署許可，因此10MW容量尚未正式交付，開始收費的時間仍未確定。公司必須先完成相關工程並交付約定容量，才能開始依合約收費。

paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。
Moneycorp交易與結構型產品主管Eugene Epstein表示，「目前有多項因素同時發揮影響，包括油價走高，以及法國的問題，因此很難判斷究竟是哪一項因素對市場的影響更大。」
「但實際來看，我認為今天市場相對處於觀望狀態。所有人都在等待聯準會(Fed)官員的談話陸續釋出，因為現在可以明顯看出，美元對各位聯準會官員的談話都相當敏感。」
然而，隨著英國海軍相關機構英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)表示，一艘船隻在阿拉伯聯合大公國半島以西13海浬處遭不明飛行物擊中，原油價格隨後自低點反彈。
美國原油上漲0.6%，報每桶92.04美元，盤中最低曾跌至90.01美元。布蘭特原油則上漲0.58%，報每桶104.88美元，稍早最低曾跌至102.33美元。
全球各地債券殖利率近幾周持續攀升，原因包括市場預期各國央行將升息，以及對政府財政狀況的憂慮。
央行政策成焦點
儘管近期經濟數據顯示通膨壓力持續存在，市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，市場認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
周五公布的密西根大學消費者調查顯示，由於中東衝突推升生活成本，美國10月初的消費者信心進一步下滑，家庭對經濟前景的看法也因此轉趨悲觀。
儘管多位聯準會官員表示，為了抑制通膨，未來仍有必要進一步升息，但也有官員反對立即升息，並指出聯準會應保持耐心與彈性，再決定未來的利率走向。
法國公債持續承壓，政界人士難以在2027年一場充滿分歧的選舉前有效削減預算赤字。本周稍早，西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，也進一步增加歐元的壓力。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.

items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐洲公債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 7th), rising to a near 18‑month high, buoyed by Fed meeting minutes that indicated a possible further rate hike and by the weakness of the euro and pound. The euro and pound were pressured by a renewed wave of global bond sell‑offs, bearing downward pressure.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 102.24, briefly touching its highest level since April 9, 2025.

Forex market participants on Wednesday focused on the Fed’s September monetary policy meeting minutes. The minutes showed that most Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) members think another rate hike could still be possible before the end of the year.

Last month the FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate by 25 basis points, the first hike in more than three years. At the same time, the updated FOMC dot‑plot also hinted at the possibility of further hikes this year. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said in the post‑meeting press conference that bringing inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target remains a major challenge.

The minutes noted, “Regarding the monetary policy outlook after this meeting, most participants believe that a further increase in the target range for the federal funds rate may be appropriate before the end of this year.”
The minutes also showed that all FOMC members supported a September rate hike.

However, as the minutes were released, market expectations for another FOMC hike at the end of the month had fallen sharply from after the September hike, mainly due to recent dovish remarks by some officials and the impact of U.S. economic growth, inflation and labor market data.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 83% probability that rates will remain unchanged at the end of the month, up from about 54% a month ago.
Euro weighed down by France’s fiscal crisis
Another boost to the dollar’s strength was the euro’s decline on Wednesday. The euro fell 0.6% against the dollar to $1.1195 per euro.

As France’s fiscal crisis deepens and Spain’s politics stall, market risk sentiment across the continent is under pressure. France’s 10‑year government bond yield has risen to its highest level since early 2000.
France’s fiscal deficit this year is projected to reach 5.4% of GDP, with public debt close to 120% of GDP.
The French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion in spending and keep the fiscal deficit target at 5% of GDP.

At the same time, France faces political uncertainty ahead of two rounds of elections in April and May next year. National Rally leader Jordan Bardella, the party’s frontrunner in the presidential race, announced on Tuesday a major budget plan targeting €140 billion in savings by 2032.
Pound weakens as UK 30‑year gilt yield hits a 1998 high
A global bond sell‑off on Wednesday spread to the UK, pushing the 30‑year gilt yield to its highest level since January 1998.
Just a day earlier, UK Treasury Secretary John Healey met with the main dealers in the gilt market, the so‑called Gilt‑edged Market Makers (GEMMs).
The Treasury said the meeting discussed the severe external environment facing the UK and global economies, including geopolitical developments and financial market conditions.
The pound fell 0.5% against the dollar to $1.3213 per pound.
